AccountDesc.description_cn: Account description information, 0–256 characters. Can include numbers, Chinese characters, English letters, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
AccountDesc.description_en: Account description information, 0–256 characters. Can include numbers, Chinese characters, English letters, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

AccountName.description_cn:
Database account name. The account name must meet the following requirements:

* The name must be unique and between 2 and 32 characters in length.
* It can contain letters, numbers, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).
* It must start with a letter and end with a letter or number.
* The name cannot contain certain prohibited words. For details, see [Prohibited Keywords](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/List_of_forbidden_keywords). You also cannot use certain reserved words, such as root, admin, etc.
AccountName.description_en:
Database account name. The account name must meet the following requirements:

* The name must be unique and between 2 and 32 characters in length.
* It can contain letters, numbers, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).
* It must start with a letter and end with a letter or number.
* The name cannot contain certain prohibited words. For details, see [Prohibited Keywords](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/List_of_forbidden_keywords). You also cannot use certain reserved words, such as root, admin, etc.

AccountPassword.description_cn:
Password for the database account. The account password must meet the following requirements:

* It can only contain uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and the following special characters: `~!@#$%^&*_-+=`|\(){}[]:;'<>,.?/`.
* The length must be between 8 and 32 characters.
* It must contain at least three of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters.
AccountPassword.description_en:
Password for the database account. The account password must meet the following requirements:

* It can only contain uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and the following special characters: `~!@#$%^&*_-+=`|\(){}[]:;'<>,.?/`.
* The length must be between 8 and 32 characters.
* It must contain at least three of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters.

AccountPrivileges.description_cn:
Database privilege information.
* When `AccountType` is set to `Super`, you do not need to provide this parameter. The high-privilege account automatically has all privileges for all databases under this instance.
* When `AccountType` is set to `Normal`, it is recommended to provide this parameter to grant specific privileges for specified databases to the normal account. If not set, the account will not have any privileges for any database.

* `DMLOnly`: DML privileges only
* `Custom`: Custom privileges

AccountPrivileges.AccountPrivilegeDetail.description_cn:
The specific SQL operation permissions included in the privilege type, with multiple strings separated by commas (,).
- When used as a request parameter in the [CreateDBAccount](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/CreateDBAccount) and [GrantDBAccountPrivilege](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/GrantDBAccountPrivilege) APIs, this parameter is required and cannot be empty when `AccountPrivilege` is set to `Custom`. Available values (multiple selections allowed): `SELECT`, `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`, `CREATE`, `DROP`, `REFERENCES`, `INDEX`, `ALTER`, `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES`, `LOCK TABLES`, `EXECUTE`, `CREATE VIEW`, `SHOW VIEW`, `CREATE ROUTINE`, `ALTER ROUTINE`, `EVENT`, `TRIGGER`.
- When used as a response parameter in the [DescribeDBAccounts](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/DescribeDBAccounts) API, the details of SQL operation permissions included in the privilege type are returned regardless of the value of `AccountPrivilege`. For details on the specific SQL operation permissions included in each privilege type, see the [Account Privilege List](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/Account_permission_description#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E6%9D%83%E9%99%90%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8).

- When used as a response parameter in the [DescribeDBAccounts](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/DescribeDBAccounts) API, the details of SQL operation permissions included in the privilege type are returned regardless of the value of `AccountPrivilege`. AccountType.description_cn:
Database account type. Values:

* `Super`: High-privilege account. Only one high-privilege account can be created per instance, and it has all privileges for all databases under the instance. It can manage all normal accounts and databases.
* `Normal`: Multiple normal accounts can be created per instance. You need to manually grant specific privileges for specified databases to normal accounts.

AutoAddNewNodes.description_cn:
Specifies whether newly created read-only nodes are automatically added to this connection endpoint. Values:

* `true`: Automatically add.
* `false`: Do not automatically add (default).
AutoAddNewNodes.description_en:

ConnectionPool.description_cn:
Configure the connection pool based on your business scenario. For details, see [Connection Pool](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/Connection_pool). Value options:

* `Off`: Disable connection pool (default)
* `Session`: Enable session-level connection pool
* `Transaction`: Enable transaction-level connection pool
ConnectionPool.description_en:

ConsistLevel.description_cn:
Consistency level. For more information, see [Consistency Level](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/Consistency_levels). Value range:

* `Eventual`: Eventual consistency.
* `Session`: Session consistency.
* `Global`: Global consistency.

* When `ReadWriteMode` is set to `ReadWrite`, you can select from `Eventual` (default), `Session`, or `Global` consistency levels.
* When `ReadWriteMode` is set to `ReadOnly`, the consistency level is `Eventual` by default and cannot be changed.
ConsistLevel.description_en:
Consistency level. For more information, see [Consistency Level](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/Consistency_levels). Value range:

* `Eventual`: Eventual consistency.
* `Session`: Session consistency.
* `Global`: Global consistency.

* When `ReadWriteMode` is set to `ReadWrite`, you can select from `Eventual` (default), `Session`, or `Global` consistency levels.
* When `ReadWriteMode` is set to `ReadOnly`, the consistency level is `Eventual` by default and cannot be changed.

ConsistTimeout.description_cn:
When latency is high, the timeout for read-only nodes to synchronize the latest data, in microseconds (us). Value range: 1us–100000000us. Default: 10000us.
This parameter takes effect only when `ConsistLevel` is set to `Global` or `Session`.
ConsistTimeout.description_en:
When latency is high, the timeout for read-only nodes to synchronize the latest data, in microseconds (us). Value range: 1us–100000000us. Default: 10000us.
This parameter takes effect only when `ConsistLevel` is set to `Global` or `Session`.

ConsistTimeoutAction.description_cn:
Timeout policy for read-only node data synchronization. The following two policies are supported:

* `ReturnError`: Return an SQL error (`wait replication complete timeout, please retry`).
* `ReadMaster`: Send the request to the primary node (default).

This parameter takes effect only when `ConsistLevel` is set to `Global` or `Session`.
ConsistTimeoutAction.description_en:
Timeout policy for read-only node data synchronization. The following two policies are supported:

* `ReturnError`: Return an SQL error (`wait replication complete timeout, please retry`).
* `ReadMaster`: Send the request to the primary node (default).

This parameter takes effect only when `ConsistLevel` is set to `Global` or `Session`.

MasterAcceptReadRequests.description_cn:
Primary node accepts read requests. Value range:

* `true`: (Default) When the primary node read feature is enabled, non-transactional read requests are sent to the primary node or read-only nodes using load balancing based on the number of active requests.
* `false`: When the primary node read feature is disabled, the primary node only accepts transactional read requests. Non-transactional read requests are not sent to the primary node.

The primary node read feature can only be enabled when `ReadWriteMode` is set to `ReadWrite`.
MasterAcceptReadRequests.description_en:
Primary node accepts read requests. Value range:

* `true`: (Default) When the primary node read feature is enabled, non-transactional read requests are sent to the primary node or read-only nodes using load balancing based on the number of active requests.
* `false`: When the primary node read feature is disabled, the primary node only accepts transactional read requests. Non-transactional read requests are not sent to the primary node.

The primary node read feature can only be enabled when `ReadWriteMode` is set to `ReadWrite`.

Nodes.description_cn:
Node IDs associated with the endpoint. Separate multiple node IDs with commas (,). Rules:

* When `ReadWriteMode` is set to `ReadWrite`, you must specify the primary node. You can optionally add read-only nodes.
      It is recommended to associate the primary node and at least one read-only node. If only the primary node is associated, read/write splitting is not supported.
   
* When `ReadWriteMode` is set to `ReadOnly`, you can specify one or more read-only nodes.

You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/DescribeDBInstanceDetail) API to query detailed information for a specified instance, including node IDs.
Nodes.description_en:

* When `ReadWriteMode` is set to `ReadOnly`, you can specify one or more read-only nodes.

You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/DescribeDBInstanceDetail) API to query detailed information for a specified instance, including node IDs.

DBEngineVersion.description_cn:
Instance compatible version. Valid values:

* `MySQL_8_0`: Compatible with community MySQL 8.0 version
* `MySQL_5_7`: Compatible with community MySQL 5.7 version

* For feature differences between instance versions, see [Feature Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/Features_overview)
* MySQL 5.7 is currently an allowlist feature. To use it, please [submit a ticket](https://console.volcengine.com/workorder/create) to contact technical support

DBMinorVersion.description_cn:
Select the veDB MySQL minor version based on compatibility. For details about version numbers, see [Version Number Management](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/Version_number_management).

* When `DBEngineVersion` is set to `MySQL_5_7`, the default value for this parameter is `2.0`.
* When `DBEngineVersion` is set to `MySQL_8_0`, valid values are:
   * `3.0` (default): veDB MySQL stable version, 100% compatible with MySQL 8.0.
   * `3.2`: Built-in cold data archiving capability. Low-frequency data can be archived to TOS object storage to reduce storage costs. For details, see [Cold and Hot Data Separation Introduction](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6357/1231210).

Cold and hot data separation is currently an allowlist feature. To use it, please [submit a ticket](https://console.volcengine.com/workorder/create) to contact technical support.

* When `DBEngineVersion` is set to `MySQL_8_0`, valid values are:

   * `3.2`: Built-in cold data archiving capability. Low-frequency data can be archived to TOS object storage to reduce storage costs. For details, see [Cold and Hot Data Separation Introduction](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6357/1231210).

DeletionProtection.description_cn:
Enable or disable instance deletion protection. Valid values:

* `enabled`: Enable.
* `disabled`: Disable (default).

Once enabled, the instance cannot be deleted. To delete the instance, you must first call the ModifyDBInstanceDeletionProtectionPolicy API to disable this feature. For more information about deletion protection, see [Instance Deletion Protection](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/Instance_deletion_protection).

InstanceName.description_cn:

* Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
* Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

* If the instance name is not specified, the instance ID will be used as the instance name
* When creating instances in bulk, if an instance name is provided, a serial number will be automatically appended to the instance name

LowerCaseTableNames.description_cn:

Valid values:

* `0`: Table names are case-sensitive; the backend stores the actual table name
* `1` (default): Table names are case-insensitive; the backend stores table names in lowercase

This rule cannot be changed after the instance is created. Set it according to your business needs

Port.description_cn:
Specify the private network port number for the default connection endpoint created for the instance. The default value is 3306. The valid range is 1000–65534.
* This configuration only applies to the **primary node endpoint** and **default endpoint**. For any custom endpoints created after the instance is created, the port number will still default to 3306.
* After the instance is created, you can modify the port number at any time. For details, see [Modify Connection Address Prefix and Port](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/Modifying_address_prefix_and_port).

ProjectName.description_cn:
Project name to which the instance belongs. If left blank, the new instance will be added to the `default` project by default.
A project is a virtual concept that includes a group of resources, users, and roles. Projects allow unified viewing and management of resources, and control permissions for users and roles within the project. For more details, see [Resource Management](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6649/94333).

StorageChargeType.description_cn:
Storage billing type. If you do not specify this parameter, the storage billing type defaults to the same value as the compute billing type. Available values:

* `PostPaid`: Pay-as-you-go (postpaid)
* `PrePaid`: Subscription (prepaid)

* If the compute billing type is set to `PostPaid`, the storage billing type can only be `PostPaid`.
* If the compute billing type is set to `PrePaid`, the storage billing type can be either `PrePaid` or `PostPaid`.

* If the compute billing type is set to `PostPaid`, the storage billing type can only be `PostPaid`.
* If the compute billing type is set to `PrePaid`, the storage billing type can be either `PrePaid` or `PostPaid`.

SubnetId.description_cn:

Available values (multiple selections allowed): `SELECT`, `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`, `CREATE`, `DROP`, `REFERENCES`, `INDEX`, `ALTER`, `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES`, `LOCK TABLES`, `EXECUTE`, `CREATE VIEW`, `SHOW VIEW`, `CREATE ROUTINE`, `ALTER ROUTINE`, `EVENT`, `TRIGGER`.
- In the [DescribeDBAccounts](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/DescribeDBAccounts) API, when used as a response parameter, the details of SQL operation privileges included in the privilege type are returned regardless of the value of `AccountPrivilege`. Instances.NodeSpecs.NodeNumber.description_cn:

At least 2 nodes are retained by default to ensure high availability (one primary, one read-only).

- When `NodeType` is `APWorkNode` (analytical node), the value range is 0–32.
- Analytical nodes are supported only when the instance has HTAP capability. For more information, see [CreateDBInstance](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/CreateDBInstance).
- To ensure service availability, it is recommended to retain at least 2 or more analytical nodes.
- Setting the number of analytical nodes to 0 deletes all analytical execution nodes. Please pay attention to business impact and proceed with caution.

AllowList.description_cn:
Enter IP addresses or IP address ranges in CIDR format.
* This parameter is required when you need to change the IP addresses in the allowlist.
* This parameter is required when specifying the ApplyInstanceNum parameter.
* Each allowlist supports up to 1000 IP addresses or CIDR-format IP address ranges. Duplicate addresses are not allowed. Separate multiple addresses with commas (,). Special examples:
   * Set 0.0.0.0/0 to allow access from all addresses.
   * Set 127.0.0.1 to deny access from all addresses.
   * Set both 0.0.0.0/0 and 127.0.0.1 to allow access from all addresses.
   * Set CIDR 192.168.1.0/24 to allow access from IP addresses in that subnet.
   * Set 192.168.1.1 to allow access only from that IP address.

AllowListName.description_cn:
Allowlist name.

* To change the allowlist name, specify the new name in this parameter. The name must meet the following requirements:
   * Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-).
   * Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
   * Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.
* If you do not need to change the allowlist name, specify the original allowlist name. You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/DescribeAllowLists) API to query all allowlist information in the specified region, including allowlist names.

ConsistLevel.description_cn:
Consistency level. For details, see [Consistency Level](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/Consistency_levels). Value range:

* `Eventual`: Eventual consistency
* `Session`: Session consistency
* `Global`: Global consistency

* When `ReadWriteMode` is set to `ReadWrite`, you can choose from `Eventual`, `Session`, or `Global` consistency levels.
* When `ReadWriteMode` is `ReadOnly`, the consistency level defaults to `Eventual` and cannot be changed.
* Changing the consistency level from eventual to session or global only affects new connections. Changing from session or global to eventual takes effect immediately for existing connections.
ConsistLevel.description_en:
Consistency level. For details, see [Consistency Level](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/Consistency_levels). Value range:

* `Eventual`: Eventual consistency
* `Session`: Session consistency
* `Global`: Global consistency

* When `ReadWriteMode` is set to `ReadWrite`, you can choose from `Eventual`, `Session`, or `Global` consistency levels.
* When `ReadWriteMode` is `ReadOnly`, the consistency level defaults to `Eventual` and cannot be changed.
* Changing the consistency level from eventual to session or global only affects new connections. Changing from session or global to eventual takes effect immediately for existing connections.

ConsistTimeout.description_cn:
When latency is high, this parameter specifies the timeout for read-only nodes to synchronize the latest data, in microseconds (us). Value range: 1us~100000000us. Default: 10000us.
This parameter takes effect only when `ConsistLevel` is set to `Global` or `Session`.
ConsistTimeout.description_en:
When latency is high, this parameter specifies the timeout for read-only nodes to synchronize the latest data, in microseconds (us). Value range: 1us~100000000us. Default: 10000us.
This parameter takes effect only when `ConsistLevel` is set to `Global` or `Session`.

ConsistTimeoutAction.description_cn:
Timeout policy for read-only node data synchronization. Supports the following two strategies:

* `ReturnError`: Returns an SQL error (`wait replication complete timeout, please retry`).
* `ReadMaster`: Sends the request to the primary node (default).

This parameter is effective only when `ConsistLevel` is set to `Global` or `Session`.

MasterAcceptReadRequests.description_cn:

* `true`: (default) When the **primary node accepts read** feature is enabled, non-transactional read requests are load balanced to the primary node or read-only nodes based on the number of active requests.
* `false`: When the **primary node accepts read** feature is disabled, the primary node only accepts transactional read requests; non-transactional read requests are not sent to the primary node.

* Only effective for default endpoints and custom read-write endpoints.
* Changes to the primary node read feature take effect immediately for all connections.

Nodes.description_cn:
The node ID of the node associated with the endpoint. Separate multiple node IDs with commas (,). Fill in according to the following rules:

* When changing `ReadWriteMode` from `ReadOnly` to `ReadWrite`, you must include the primary node. You can also include read-only nodes as needed.
      It is recommended to associate the primary node and at least one read-only node. If only the primary node is associated, read/write splitting is not supported.
   
* When changing `ReadWriteMode` from `ReadWrite` to `ReadOnly`, you can include one or more read-only nodes, but not the primary node.

* This parameter is required when you change the endpoint's read/write mode, that is, when you change the value of `ReadWriteMode`.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/DescribeDBInstanceDetail) API to query detailed information about a specified instance, including node IDs.

* When changing `ReadWriteMode` from `ReadWrite` to `ReadOnly`, you can include one or more read-only nodes, but not the primary node.

Set storage space size. Supported storage space sizes vary by instance specification. For details, see [Product Specifications](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/Product_specifications)

* If this parameter is not provided, the storage space size defaults to `current used space` + `15GB`
* When customizing storage space size, it is recommended to select a size greater than the current used storage space. If less than the used storage space, the excess will be billed as pay-as-you-go. AccountPassword.description_cn:
New password for the database account. The account password must meet the following requirements:

* Only uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and the following special characters are allowed: `_#!@$%^&*()+=-`.
* Length must be between 8 and 32 characters.
* Must contain at least three of the following types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters.

BackupId.description_cn:
Backup file ID. You can query the `BackupID` by calling the [DescribeBackups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/DescribeBackups) API.
Either this parameter or the RestoreTime parameter is required.
BackupId.description_en:

InstanceId.description_cn: Instance ID to which the backup data belongs
InstanceId.description_en: Instance ID to which the backup data belongs

RestoreTime.description_cn:
Any point in time within the backup retention period of the instance, in the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC time). You can query the recoverable time range for the instance backup by calling [DescribeRecoverableTime](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/DescribeRecoverableTime).
Either this parameter or the BackupId parameter is required.
RestoreTime.description_en:

Either this parameter or the BackupId parameter is required.

TableMeta.description_cn:
When restoring databases and tables, specify the information of the databases and tables to be restored.
You can call the [DescribeRecoverableTables](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/DescribeRecoverableTables) API to view the recoverable databases and tables for the instance.
TableMeta.description_en:
When restoring databases and tables, specify the information of the databases and tables to be restored.
You can call the [DescribeRecoverableTables](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/DescribeRecoverableTables) API to view the recoverable databases and tables for the instance.

TableMeta.DBName.description_cn: Name of the database to restore.
TableMeta.DBName.description_en: Name of the database to restore.

TableMeta.NewDBName.description_cn:
New database name after restoration.
`NewDBName` (new database name) cannot be the same as `DBName` (original database name), otherwise the database and table restoration operation will fail.
TableMeta.NewDBName.description_en:
New database name after restoration.
`NewDBName` (new database name) cannot be the same as `DBName` (original database name), otherwise the database and table restoration operation will fail.

TableMeta.Table.description_cn:
Table to restore in the database.
- If `Table` is empty, all tables in the specified database will be restored.
- You can restore up to 100 databases and tables in a single operation.
TableMeta.Table.description_en:
Table to restore in the database.

AutoRenew.description_cn:

- `true`: auto-renewal
- `false`: do not auto-renew
This parameter is required when `ChargeType` (billing type) is set to `PrePaid` (annual/monthly subscription)

Enter the backup file ID of the original instance. Use the data saved in this backup file to create a new instance.

- You can call [DescribeBackups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/DescribeBackups) to query the backup file list information for the specified instance.

Port.description_cn:
Specify the private network port number for the default connection endpoint of the instance. The default value is 3306. Valid range: 1000–65534.
- This configuration applies only to the **primary node endpoint**, **default endpoint**. After the instance is created, any new custom endpoints will still default to port 3306.
- After the instance is created, you can modify the port number at any time. Currently, you can only change the port number in the console. For details, see [Modify Connection Address Prefix and Port](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/Modifying_address_prefix_and_port).
Port.description_en:

- After the instance is created, you can modify the port number at any time. Currently, you can only change the port number in the console. For details, see [Modify Connection Address Prefix and Port](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/Modifying_address_prefix_and_port).

ProjectName.description_cn:
Project name. If left blank during creation, it is added to the `default` project by default.
A project is a virtual concept that includes a group of resources, users, and roles. Projects let you view and manage resources as a group, and control the permissions of users and roles to manage these resources. For more details, see [Resource Management](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6649/94333).

SubnetId.description_cn:
Subnet ID. The subnet must belong to the selected availability zone.
- A subnet is an IP address block within a private network. All cloud resources in the private network must be deployed in a subnet, which assigns private IP addresses to cloud resources.
- You can use the [CreateSubnet](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/CreateSubnet) API to create a subnet, and the [DescribeSubnets](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeSubnets) API to query the list of all subnets in a specified availability zone, including subnet IDs.

Tags.description_cn:

- Tag keys and values must follow the configuration rules. For details, see [Tag configuration rules](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/NDB_for_MySQL/Tag_overview#标签设置规则).

Async.description_en:
Choose whether to use asynchronous mode for cancellation requests
- true: Asynchronous mode; the request returns immediately without waiting for cancellation to complete
- false (default): Synchronous mode; the request waits until cancellation succeeds or fails

Cell.description_en: Assign the function to a specific CELL cluster

CodeSizeLimit.description_en: Code package size limit is only visible to administrators or whitelisted users. Default is 64MB; native functions default to 256MB

Command.description_en: Custom startup command for instance (currently supports only native/v1 runtime)

CpuMilli.description_en: Maximum CPU per instance (unit: milli CPU). When using CPU instance mode, you can set the CPU specification for a single CPU instance.

CpuStrategy.description_en: Function CPU billing policy: When creating a function of the microservice application type, this field must be set to `always` to ensure at least one instance is running

Description.description_en: Function description. Limit to 1000 Unicode characters or fewer.

EnableBilling.description_en: Available only when controlplane enables the billing switch. Currently, controlplane enables the billing switch only in SIT

EnableImageCache.description_en: Supports manually enabling image cache for custom images

EnableZTIToken.description_en: Enable/Disable zti token write feature (function level)

ExclusiveMode.description_en:
Exclusive mode switch. Values:

* **true**: Disables multi-concurrency per instance, meaning each instance can only process one request at a time (exclusive mode)
* **false** (default): Enables multi-concurrency per instance, meaning each instance can process multiple requests at the same time (non-exclusive mode). You can set the maximum concurrent requests per instance using MaxConcurrency

Id.description_en: Specify function ID (dedicated small framework). Activation requires whitelisting.

InstanceType.description_en:
Instance type for function instance

* If Instance Type is empty, it is a CPU instance
* If Instance Type is not empty, it is a GPU instance

MaxConcurrency.description_en:
Maximum concurrency per instance. Applies when `ExclusiveMode = false`.

* Value range: 10~1000
* Default: 100

MemoryMB.description_en:
Maximum memory per instance.

* Unit: MiB
* Value range: 512~4096
      Values increase in steps of 512.
   
* Default: 1024

Name.description_en:
Function name

* Function names must be unique within the same account
* Supports uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens (-), and underscores (_); length must be 4~64 characters

Port.description_en: Custom listening port for the instance (currently supports only native/v1 runtime)

ProjectName.description_en: Project name associated with the function

Protocol.description_en: Function protocol framework

RequestTimeout.description_en:
Request timeout

* Unit: seconds
* Value range: 1~900
* Default: 30

Role.description_en: Bind IAM role to function instance

Runtime.description_en:
Function runtime. Values:

* **golang/v1**
* **native/v1**
* **nativejava8/v1**
* **node14/v1**
* **node20/v1**
* **nodeprime14/v1**
* **python3.12/v1**
* **python3.8/v1**
* **python3.9/v1**

When `SourceType = image`, Runtime must be `native/v1`

Source.description_en:
Code source. Values:

* **zip**: Binary ZIP file encoded in Base64
* **tos**: String in the format `bucket_name:object_key`, for example: `vefaas-test:vefaas-python38-default.zip`
* **image**: Image address in the format `host/namespace/repo:tag`. For example: `cp-enterprise-cn-beijing.cr.volces.com/demo/nginx:latest`

SourceAccessConfig.description_en:
Image repository access configuration
When setting a custom image across accounts, you need to provide access configuration

SourceType.description_en:
Code source type. Values:

* **tos**: Volcengine Object Storage (TOS)
* **zip**: Local compressed file
* **image**: Volcengine Image Repository (CR), supports Basic and Enterprise editions

BatchFlushDurationMilliseconds.description_en: Maximum wait time for batch trigger consumption. Unit: milliseconds (ms). Range: 1000–60000 ms. Default: 1000 ms

BatchSize.description_en: Number of messages per batch for trigger batch consumption. Recommended value: no more than 1000

Description.description_en: Kafka Trigger Description

Enabled.description_en: Enable Kafka Trigger

Envs.description_en: Envs are the environment variables for the eventsource pod

KafkaCredentials.description_en: Kafka authentication. The function service will use Kafka ACL policies to authenticate message consumption for SASL users with PLAIN and SCRAM-SHA-256 types. Please configure the Kafka instance username and password with the required permissions in the trigger.

Name.description_en: Kafka trigger name. Use 4–63 characters, starting with a letter. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores are allowed

StartingPosition.description_en:
Trigger Start Consumption Position

SnapshotId.description_en:
Snapshot ID for forking a new instance from a snapshot (optional)
Once set, this request switches to the "Fork from snapshot" mode:
  - Fields such as sandbox image, Port, Command, TOS/NAS/EBS/EmptyDir, Metadata, RoleChainTrn, RoleTrn
    are all sourced from the snapshot itself; corresponding fields in the request body will be ignored
  - Timeout / TimeoutUnit / SessionId / Async / CpuMilli / MemoryMB / RequestTimeout / MaxConcurrency
    can be overridden by this request; CpuMilli / MemoryMB must be >= the specs recorded in the snapshot, otherwise InvalidParameter is returned
  - Envs support key-based merge and override: environment variables with the same name in the request override snapshot values, other variables from the snapshot are retained
  - If Sidecars are provided, they completely replace the sidecars in the snapshot (an empty list means no sidecar is used); if not provided, the snapshot configuration is used
  - InstanceTosMountConfig supports adding mounts during fork:
      * If the snapshot itself does not have TOS mounts: the configuration in the request will be used as the mount point for the forked instance
      * If the snapshot already includes TOS mounts: mount points in the request will be appended after the snapshot mount points
        After merging, all LocalMountPath values must be globally unique (no conflicts between TOS and EBS)
        If there is a conflict, InvalidParameter is returned; the request cannot override original mount points from the snapshot

 warning

LoggingConfig.LogProjectId.description_cn:
Cluster Log Project (Log Project) ID
* Cannot be an empty string
* When creating a cluster, if `LogProjectId` is not provided, the system will automatically create a new log project
* If the system automatically creates a log project, the project name is generated in the format `k8s-log-{clusterId}-{6 random characters}`
* If the `LogSetups.Enabled` field is set to `false`, the system will not automatically create a log project
* When updating cluster configuration, if `LogProjectId` has already specified a log project, it cannot be updated to empty
* When updating cluster configuration, if the cluster does not have any log configuration and only `LogProjectId` is provided while `LogSetups` is empty, `LogProjectId` will be ignored
* Updating `LogProjectId` will create a new topic for logs that are enabled

MaintenanceWindowConfig.Duration.description_cn:

If this parameter is not configured, the default value is 4.
MaintenanceWindowConfig.Duration.description_en:
Duration of automated O&M, integer value, valid range is 4–24, unit: hours.
If this parameter is not configured, the default value is 4.

MaintenanceWindowConfig.ExemptEndDate.description_cn:
End time of the automated O&M exemption window. Format: `YYYYMMDD`, based on Beijing time (UTC +8) calendar days. For example, if set to `20260704`, automated O&M tasks will not be performed up to and including 23:59:59 on that date.
This date must be later than the date configured for `ExemptStartDate` and cannot exceed 60 days.
MaintenanceWindowConfig.ExemptEndDate.description_en:
End time of the automated O&M exemption window. Format: `YYYYMMDD`, based on Beijing time (UTC +8) calendar days. For example, if set to `20260704`, automated O&M tasks will not be performed up to and including 23:59:59 on that date.
This date must be later than the date configured for `ExemptStartDate` and cannot exceed 60 days.

MaintenanceWindowConfig.ExemptStartDate.description_cn:
Start time of the automated O&M exemption window. Format: `YYYYMMDD`, based on Beijing time (UTC +8) calendar days. For example, if set to `20260702`, automated O&M tasks will not be performed starting from 00:00:00 on that date.
* This date must be earlier than the date configured for `ExemptEndDate` and cannot exceed 60 days.
* In scenarios such as critical business protection or network lockdown, you can configure the exemption window to disable automated O&M operations.
MaintenanceWindowConfig.ExemptStartDate.description_en:
Start time of the automated O&M exemption window. Format: `YYYYMMDD`, based on Beijing time (UTC +8) calendar days. For example, if set to `20260702`, automated O&M tasks will not be performed starting from 00:00:00 on that date.
* This date must be earlier than the date configured for `ExemptEndDate` and cannot exceed 60 days.
* In scenarios such as critical business protection or network lockdown, you can configure the exemption window to disable automated O&M operations.

MaintenanceWindowConfig.StartTime.description_cn:
Start time for automated O&M, Golang standard time format, 24-hour clock. Valid values are whole hours from 00 to 23. For example: 01:00:00Z, 14:00:00Z.
If this parameter is not configured, the default value is 16:00:00Z, which is 16:00 UTC and 00:00:00 the next day in Beijing time (UTC +8).
* This parameter currently only supports UTC standard time. If you need to use another time zone, manually convert the time to UTC standard time.
* The `ExemptStartDate` and `ExemptEndDate` parameters default to UTC +8 time zone. When configured together with this parameter, ensure time zone consistency.
MaintenanceWindowConfig.StartTime.description_en:
Start time for automated O&M, Golang standard time format, 24-hour clock. Valid values are whole hours from 00 to 23. For example: 01:00:00Z, 14:00:00Z.
If this parameter is not configured, the default value is 16:00:00Z, which is 16:00 UTC and 00:00:00 the next day in Beijing time (UTC +8).
* This parameter currently only supports UTC standard time. If you need to use another time zone, manually convert the time to UTC standard time.
* The `ExemptStartDate` and `ExemptEndDate` parameters default to UTC +8 time zone. When configured together with this parameter, ensure time zone consistency.

* The number of Pods in the cluster is limited by the number of IPs in this CIDR. This cannot be changed after the cluster is created. Plan the Pod CIDR carefully.
* Must not overlap with the following network segments:
   * The private network segments corresponding to **ClusterConfig.SubnetIds** in the same cluster
   * The segments corresponding to **ServiceConfig.ServiceCidrsv4** in the same cluster
   * The segments corresponding to **ServiceConfig.ServiceCidrsv4** for all clusters in the same private network
   * **FlannelConfig.PodCidrs** (this parameter) for different clusters in the same private network
PodsConfig.FlannelConfig.PodCidrs.description_en:
Pod CIDR for the Flannel container network model.
Can be configured only when `PodNetworkMode=Flannel`, but is optional.
* The number of Pods in the cluster is limited by the number of IPs in this CIDR. This cannot be changed after the cluster is created. Plan the Pod CIDR carefully.
* Must not overlap with the following network segments:
   * The private network segments corresponding to **ClusterConfig.SubnetIds** in the same cluster
   * The segments corresponding to **ServiceConfig.ServiceCidrsv4** in the same cluster
   * The segments corresponding to **ServiceConfig.ServiceCidrsv4** for all clusters in the same private network
   * **FlannelConfig.PodCidrs** (this parameter) for different clusters in the same private network

PodsConfig.FlannelConfig.SubnetIds.description_cn:
VPC subnet used by VCI Pods, for assigning IP addresses to VCI Pods.
Can be configured only when `PodNetworkMode=Flannel`, but is optional.
You can call the [Private Network API](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/API-overview-1) to obtain the subnet ID.
When creating a cluster, make sure all specified **SubnetIds** (including but not limited to this parameter) belong to the same private network.
PodsConfig.FlannelConfig.SubnetIds.description_en:
VPC subnet used by VCI Pods, for assigning IP addresses to VCI Pods.
Can be configured only when `PodNetworkMode=Flannel`, but is optional.

PodsConfig.PodNetworkMode.description_cn:
Container (Pod) network model (CNI), options:

* **Flannel**: Flannel network model. An independent underlay container network solution that works with the global routing capabilities of the private network (VPC) to deliver high-performance networking for the cluster.
* **VpcCniShared**: VPC-CNI network model. An underlay container network solution based on elastic network interface (ENI) in the private network, offering high network communication performance.

This parameter cannot be modified after the cluster is created. Please configure it appropriately.

ProjectName.description_cn:

ServicesConfig.ServiceCidrsv4.description_cn:
CIDR used by services within the cluster.

Tags.description_cn:
Custom resource tags are used to categorize, search, and aggregate clusters with similar characteristics from different perspectives, enabling flexible cluster management.

* Each **Key** in **Tags** must be unique
* If a resource already has the same **Tags.Key**, binding the same **Tags.Key** again will not cause an error; it will update to the latest **Tags.Value**
* A single resource supports up to 50 **Tags**
* Leading or trailing spaces are not allowed in **Tags** **Key** or **Value**

Type.description_en:

ClientToken.description_cn: String used to ensure request idempotency. The caller must provide this string and ensure it is unique for each request. ClientToken is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters.

The cluster must be in the `{Running,[Ok]}` or `{Updating,[Progressing]}` state. You can call the [ListClusters](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListClusters) API to check the current status of the cluster.

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.Concur.description_cn:

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.Concur.description_en:

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.MaxCon.description_cn:
Maximum number of image layers that containerd can download concurrently during a single image pull.

* Must be a positive integer; default is 3.

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.MaxCon.description_en:

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.UseLoc.description_cn:

* **best-effort**: kubelet prefers Pods that achieve NUMA on CPU and device resources
* **single-numa-node**: kubelet only allows Pods that achieve NUMA on CPU and device resources within the same node

KubernetesConfig.Labels.description_cn:

NodeConfig.InitializeScript.description_cn:

NodeConfig.Security.Login.Password.description_cn:
Root user login password, encoded in Base64.
Follow the cloud server requirements for instance passwords:

* Length must be 8–30 characters

   * Lowercase letters `a`~`z`
   * Uppercase letters `A`~`Z`

AutoScaling.Priority.description_en:

AutoScaling.SubnetPolicy.description_cn:
Multi-subnet scheduling policy for the node pool, used to schedule expansion of worker nodes according to subnet priority order. Values:

* **ZoneBalance**: Availability zone balancing policy. When scaling out nodes, new nodes are distributed across subnets in multiple availability zones to ensure the number of nodes in each zone remains relatively balanced.
* **Priority**: Subnet priority policy. Scheduling follows the order of the subnet list. If the highest-priority subnet can be created successfully, new nodes are always added to that subnet.
AutoScaling.SubnetPolicy.description_en:

* **Priority**: Subnet priority policy. Scheduling follows the order of the subnet list. If the highest-priority subnet can be created successfully, new nodes are always added to that subnet.

NodeConfig.GpuDriverConfig.GpuDriverVers.description_cn:
Specify the GPU driver version to be installed on the node.

* You can call the [ListSupportedGpuDriverVersions](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListSupportedGpuDriverVersions) API to obtain the list of GPU driver versions supported by the image.
* If this parameter is left empty, the system will automatically fill in the recommended GPU driver version based on the GPU model.

If you specify multiple ECS instance types in the node pool, supported GPU drivers may differ between instance types. You must specify a GPU driver version supported by all selected instance types; otherwise, an error will occur.
NodeConfig.GpuDriverConfig.GpuDriverVers.description_en:

If you specify multiple ECS instance types in the node pool, supported GPU drivers may differ between instance types. You must specify a GPU driver version supported by all selected instance types; otherwise, an error will occur.

NodeConfig.GpuDriverConfig.InstallGpuDri.description_cn:
When the ECS instance corresponding to the node is a GPU model and uses a public base image (such as veLinux 1.0 or Ubuntu 22.04), specify whether to automatically install the GPU driver. Valid values:

* **true**: Automatically install the GPU driver. When set to this value, you can use the `GpuDriverVersion` parameter to specify the GPU driver version.
* **false**: Do not automatically install the GPU driver.

This configuration does not take effect when the ECS instance is not a GPU model.

NodeConfig.HpcClusterIds.description_cn:
High Performance Computing Cluster ID

When creating a **High Performance Computing GPU** node pool, you must specify a High Performance Computing Cluster ID. You can find the ID on the **Instances & Images** > **High Performance Computing Cluster** page in the [Cloud Server Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs).

- Only one High Performance Computing Cluster ID is supported. For more information, see [High Performance Computing Cluster Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/gpu/HPC-cluster-overview).
- Make sure the specified High Performance Computing Cluster and the subnet specified in **SubnetIds** are in the same availability zone.
NodeConfig.HpcClusterIds.description_en:
High Performance Computing Cluster ID

When creating a **High Performance Computing GPU** node pool, you must specify a High Performance Computing Cluster ID. You can find the ID on the **Instances & Images** > **High Performance Computing Cluster** page in the [Cloud Server Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs).

- Only one High Performance Computing Cluster ID is supported. For more information, see [High Performance Computing Cluster Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/gpu/HPC-cluster-overview).
- Make sure the specified High Performance Computing Cluster and the subnet specified in **SubnetIds** are in the same availability zone.

NodeConfig.ImageId.description_cn:

Different image types require different image IDs. For details, see [Public images supported by Container Service](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/Overview-of-operating-system-images#%E5%AE%B9%E5%99%A8%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E7%9A%84%E5%85%AC%E5%85%B1%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F).

* If this parameter is not specified, a veLinux 2.0 series image ID is prioritized for allocation.
* When multiple specifications are provided, this parameter is required.

NodeConfig.InstanceTypeIds.description_cn:

* Up to ten array elements are supported.

NodeConfig.InstancesDistribution.Capacit.description_cn:
Enable on-demand instance supplementation for preemptible capacity. Parameter value description:

* **true**: Enabled. Before preemptible instances are about to be reclaimed, proactively create new preemptible instances for compensation.
* **false**: Disabled. Scale up to replenish the number of instances only after preemptible instances are reclaimed.

For more information, see [Preemptible Instance Node Pool](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/Preemptible_instance_node_pool).
NodeConfig.InstancesDistribution.Capacit.description_en:
Enable on-demand instance supplementation for preemptible capacity. Parameter value description:

* **true**: Enabled. Before preemptible instances are about to be reclaimed, proactively create new preemptible instances for compensation.
* **false**: Disabled. Scale up to replenish the number of instances only after preemptible instances are reclaimed.

For more information, see [Preemptible Instance Node Pool](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/Preemptible_instance_node_pool).

NodeConfig.InstancesDistribution.Compens.description_cn:
Enable on-demand instance replacement. Parameter value description:

* **true**: Enabled. If all preemptible instances fail to be purchased due to insufficient inventory or other reasons, attempt to purchase on-demand instances.
* **false**: Disabled. Only attempt to purchase the configured preemptible instances when scaling up preemptible capacity.
NodeConfig.InstancesDistribution.Compens.description_en:

* Hyphens `-` cannot be used consecutively

NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.Bandwidth.description_cn:

* When `BillingType=2`: 1 ~ 500
* When `BillingType=3`: 1 ~ 200

Peak bandwidth for public IP, in Mbps. Value range:

* When `BillingType=2`: 1 ~ 500
* When `BillingType=3`: 1 ~ 200

NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.BandwidthP.description_cn:
This is the shared bandwidth package ID, which is used when adding a public IP to the shared bandwidth package.
To obtain the shared bandwidth package ID, call the [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/bandwidthpackage/DescribeBandwidthPackages) API.
When adding a public IP to a shared bandwidth package, you must meet all of the following conditions:

* Both must have the same line type
* The shared bandwidth package must be IPv4 type
* The shared bandwidth package must not have security protection configured
NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.BandwidthP.description_en:

To obtain the shared bandwidth package ID, call the [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/bandwidthpackage/DescribeBandwidthPackages) API.
When adding a public IP to a shared bandwidth package, you must meet all of the following conditions:

* Both must have the same line type
* The shared bandwidth package must be IPv4 type
* The shared bandwidth package must not have security protection configured

NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.BillingTyp.description_cn:
Billing type for public IP. Options:

* **3**: Pay-as-you-go—billed by actual outbound traffic. After specifying the bandwidth cap, charges are based on actual outbound public network traffic, regardless of usage duration.
* **2**: Pay-as-you-go—billed by bandwidth cap. After specifying the bandwidth cap, charges are based on usage duration, regardless of actual traffic.
NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.BillingTyp.description_en:
Billing type for public IP. Options:

* **3**: Pay-as-you-go—billed by actual outbound traffic. After specifying the bandwidth cap, charges are based on actual outbound public network traffic, regardless of usage duration.
* **2**: Pay-as-you-go—billed by bandwidth cap. After specifying the bandwidth cap, charges are based on usage duration, regardless of actual traffic.

NodeConfig.PublicAccessEnabled.description_cn:

* **false**: (Default) Disabled. The system will not automatically assign EIP to nodes. If you need public network access later, see [Apply for Public IP and Bind to Cloud Server](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/eip/Applying-for-an-EIP-and-associating-an-ECS-instance).
* **true**: Enabled. The system automatically assigns EIP to nodes in the cluster. At this time, you also need to configure the **PublicAccessConfig** parameter to customize EIP settings.
NodeConfig.PublicAccessEnabled.description_en:
Enable automatic public IP (EIP) binding for nodes. Options:

* **false**: (Default) Disabled. The system will not automatically assign EIP to nodes. If you need public network access later, see [Apply for Public IP and Bind to Cloud Server](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/eip/Applying-for-an-EIP-and-associating-an-ECS-instance).
* **true**: Enabled. The system automatically assigns EIP to nodes in the cluster. At this time, you also need to configure the **PublicAccessConfig** parameter to customize EIP settings.

NodeConfig.Security.Login.Password.description_cn:
Root user login password, encoded in Base64.
Follow the cloud server requirements for instance passwords:

* Length must be 8–30 characters
* Cannot start with `/` or `$6$`
* Must include at least three of the following character types:
   * Lowercase letters `a`~`z`
   * Uppercase letters `A`~`Z`
   * Numbers `0`~`9`
   * Special characters `( ) ` ~ ! @ # $ % ^ & * _ - + = | { } [ ] : ; ' < > , . ? /`
NodeConfig.Security.Login.Password.description_en:
Root user login password, encoded in Base64.

* Must include at least three of the following character types:
   * Lowercase letters `a`~`z`
   * Uppercase letters `A`~`Z`

NodeConfig.Security.SecurityGroupIds.description_cn:
List of security group IDs for the node network.
Call the [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeSecurityGroups) API in the private network to obtain security group IDs.
* Must be in the same private network as the cluster
* If left empty, the **default security group for cluster nodes** (named <ClusterID>-common) is used by default. For details about the default security group, see [Security Group Settings](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/Security-group-settings)
* A single node pool can be associated with up to 5 security groups (including the default security group for cluster nodes)
NodeConfig.Security.SecurityGroupIds.description_en:

AdditionalContainerStorageEnabled.description_cn:
Select and configure a node's data disk, format and mount it as the storage directory for container images and logs. Values:

* **false** (default): Disabled
   * Default node pool: Data disk will not be mounted.
   * Custom node pool: Mounting uses the node pool's data disk configuration. The ECS instance data disk added to the node pool must include the data disk specified for mounting by the target node pool (including local disks), and the disk type and size must match exactly.
* **true**: Enabled. You must also configure the **ContainerStoragePath** parameter. The node will mount according to the configuration in the **ContainerStoragePath** parameter, ignoring the node pool's data disk configuration. There are no special requirements for the ECS instance data disk added to the node pool.

* **true**: Enabled. You must also configure the **ContainerStoragePath** parameter. The node will mount according to the configuration in the **ContainerStoragePath** parameter, ignoring the node pool's data disk configuration. There are no special requirements for the ECS instance data disk added to the node pool.

ContainerStorageMountPoint.description_cn: Target mount directory for the formatted data disk device. Use together with `ContainerStoragePath`. If not specified, mounts to the default directory. Effective only when `AdditionalContainerStorageEnabled=true`.
ContainerStorageMountPoint.description_en: Target mount directory for the formatted data disk device. Use together with `ContainerStoragePath`. If not specified, mounts to the default directory. Effective only when `AdditionalContainerStorageEnabled=true`.

ContainerStoragePath.description_cn:
Use this data disk device to mount the `/var/lib/containerd` directory for container and image storage.
This parameter is only valid when `AdditionalContainerStorageEnabled=true` and must not be empty.
The following conditions must be met, otherwise initialization will fail:

* Only ECS instances with mounted data disks are supported.
* If you specify a data disk device name, ensure the device exists; otherwise, initialization will fail.
* If you specify a data disk partition or logical volume name, ensure the partition or logical volume exists and uses the ext4 file system.

* If you specify a data disk device, it will be automatically formatted and mounted directly. Please back up your data in advance.
* If you specify a data disk partition or logical volume name, formatting is not required.

GpuDriverConfig.GpuDriverVersion.description_cn:

* You can call the [ListSupportedGpuDriverVersions](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListSupportedGpuDriverVersions) API to obtain the list of GPU driver versions supported by the image.
* If this parameter is left empty, the system will automatically fill in the recommended GPU driver version based on the GPU model.

If you specify multiple ECS instance types in the node pool, supported GPU drivers may differ between instance types. You must specify a GPU driver version supported by all selected instance types; otherwise, an error will occur.

If you specify multiple ECS instance types in the node pool, supported GPU drivers may differ between instance types. You must specify a GPU driver version supported by all selected instance types; otherwise, an error will occur.

GpuDriverConfig.InstallGpuDriver.description_cn:

* **true**: Automatically install the GPU driver. When set to this value, you can use the `GpuDriverVersion` parameter to specify the GPU driver version.
* **false**: Do not automatically install the GPU driver.

This configuration does not take effect when the ECS instance is not a GPU model.

InitializeScript.description_cn:
Script executed after you create ECS nodes and deploy Kubernetes components. Enter a Shell script encoded in Base64.

* If you leave this field empty, the node inherits the default initialization script from the node pool configuration (`NodeConfig.InitializeScript`).
* If you enter a custom script, the system uses your custom script and ignores the default node pool initialization script.

The Base64-encoded script must not exceed 8 KB. If you provide both **InitializeScript** and **PreScript**, the combined length of both parameters must not exceed 8 KB.
InitializeScript.description_en:

The Base64-encoded script must not exceed 8 KB. If you provide both **InitializeScript** and **PreScript**, the combined length of both parameters must not exceed 8 KB.

InstanceIds.description_cn:
ECS instance IDs to add to the cluster. You can specify up to 100 ECS instance IDs in a single request.
Call the [DescribeInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeInstances) API to obtain ECS instance IDs. The ECS instances must meet the following requirements:

* Located in the same VPC as the cluster
* Not used by another cluster
* Instance status must be **Running** (`Running`)
* The number of nodes added cannot exceed the cluster's maximum supported node count
* Do not add the same ECS instance more than once

If you are adding ECS instances to a custom node pool, note the following:

* If the node pool has **AffinityGroupConfig** enabled (invite-only), the number of ECS instance IDs entered here must be a multiple of the affinity group specification; otherwise, the addition will fail
* If the node pool does not have **AffinityGroupConfig** enabled (invite-only), specifying affinity group ECS instance IDs may cause unexpected behavior. We recommend not selecting affinity group ECS instances in node pools purchased without affinity group configuration

Validation rules:

* Supports English letters, numbers, and hyphens (-); hyphens (-) cannot be used consecutively
* Must start with an English letter and end with an English letter or number
* Length must be 2–51 characters

NodePoolId.description_cn:
Node pool ID

* If no parameter value is provided: existing ECS instances will be added to the default node pool.
* If a parameter value is provided: existing ECS instances will be added to a custom node pool. You can call the [ListNodePools](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListNodePools) API to obtain the target custom node pool ID.

If you enter a **custom node pool ID** here, the nodes to be added will use the Kubernetes configuration and node settings from the custom node pool (including ECS instance tags, labels, taints, node blocking configuration, project, node name prefix, etc). Therefore, the **InitializeScript**, **KubernetesConfig**, and **ImageId** parameter settings will be ignored. These parameters are only valid when adding existing nodes to the default node pool.
NodePoolId.description_en:
Node pool ID

* If no parameter value is provided: existing ECS instances will be added to the default node pool.
* If a parameter value is provided: existing ECS instances will be added to a custom node pool. You can call the [ListNodePools](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListNodePools) API to obtain the target custom node pool ID.

If you enter a **custom node pool ID** here, the nodes to be added will use the Kubernetes configuration and node settings from the custom node pool (including ECS instance tags, labels, taints, node blocking configuration, project, node name prefix, etc). Therefore, the **InitializeScript**, **KubernetesConfig**, and **ImageId** parameter settings will be ignored. These parameters are only valid when adding existing nodes to the default node pool.

PreScript.description_cn:

* If the parameter value is empty, the node to be added inherits the default node pool's pre-script configuration **NodeConfigRequest.PreScript**
* If you enter a custom script, the default node pool pre-script will be ignored and the script entered here will be used
* The length after Base64 encoding must not exceed 8 KB. If both **InitializeScript** and **PreScript** are provided, the total length of both parameters must not exceed 8 KB

SkipReplaceSystem.description_cn:

* **true**: Skip system reset; the operating system of the ECS instance for the existing node will not be reset
* **false** (default): Do not skip system reset; the operating system of the ECS instance for the existing node will be reset

If you need to skip system reset (set to `true`), make sure:

* The ECS instance status is **RUNNING**. You can call [DescribeInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeInstances) to check the instance status
* The ECS instance has Cloud Assistant Agent installed and its status is **Running**. You can call [DescribeCloudAssistantStatus](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeCloudAssistantStatus) to check the Cloud Assistant Agent status

Automatic release time for reserved instances, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Only valid and required when `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Segmented` (**Elastic Scheduled Instance - Time Segment Type**). Must be on a 10-minute mark.

* If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve` (**reservation delivery** type), this time must be greater than reservation delivery +1 hour
* If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (**immediate delivery** type), the earliest release time is the next 10-minute mark after the current time. For example, if the current time is 5:02, the earliest automatic release time is 5:20

* If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (**immediate delivery** type), the earliest release time is the next 10-minute mark after the current time. For example, if the current time is 5:02, the earliest automatic release time is 5:20

ScheduledInstancePolicy.BestEffort.description_cn:
When the inventory of elastic scheduled instances cannot fully meet the reservation demand, choose whether to reserve as many instances as possible.

* **false:** (default) Generates at most one reservation order
* **true:** If a single reservation order cannot meet the demand, multiple reservation orders will be submitted

ScheduledInstancePolicy.EndDeliveryTime.description_cn:
End time for delivery of elastic scheduled instances, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Must be on a 10-minute mark, and the interval with `StartDeliveryTime` must be 10 minutes. Values:

* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Esi` (**Elastic Scheduled Instance - General Type**), this is required and valid:
   * Value must be within 4–8 hours after the start time of the periodic task (`LaunchTime`)
* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Segmented` (**Elastic Scheduled Instance - Time Segment Type**):
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve` (reservation delivery type), this is required and valid. Value must be within 24 hours after the start time of the periodic task (`LaunchTime`)
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (immediate delivery type), this parameter does not need to be provided

ScheduledPolicy.LaunchTime.description_cn:
Task start time, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Scheduled` or `Recurrence`.

* When `Type` is `Scheduled`, this is the trigger time for the scheduled task.
* When `Type` is `Recurrence`, this is the start time for the recurring task.
* Must be later than the current time, and can only be set within 90 days from the creation/modification time.

To ensure the scheduled scaling request is submitted successfully, it is recommended to set `LaunchTime` at least 1 minute later than the current time.
ScheduledPolicy.LaunchTime.description_en:

* When `Type` is `Scheduled`, this is the trigger time for the scheduled task.

To ensure the scheduled scaling request is submitted successfully, it is recommended to set `LaunchTime` at least 1 minute later than the current time.

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceEndTime.description_cn:
End time of the recurring task, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`.
Must be greater than or equal to `LaunchTime`, and can only be set within 365 days from the creation/modification time.
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceEndTime.description_en:

Must be greater than or equal to `LaunchTime`, and can only be set within 365 days from the creation/modification time.

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType.description_cn:
Recurrence period for the recurring task. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`. Options:

* **Daily**: Execute once every few days.
* **Weekly**: Select specific days of the week to execute once per day.
* **Monthly**: Select specific dates within the month to execute once per day.
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType.description_en:
Recurrence period for the recurring task. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`. Options:

* **Daily**: Execute once every few days.
* **Weekly**: Select specific days of the week to execute once per day.
* **Monthly**: Select specific dates within the month to execute once per day.

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceValue.description_cn:
Number of times a recurring task is executed. This field is required and only valid when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`.

* When `RecurrenceType` is set to `Daily`, only one value can be entered, with a range of 1–31.
* When `RecurrenceType` is set to `Weekly`, multiple values are supported, separated by commas (`,`). Values for Monday to Sunday are: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7.
* When `RecurrenceType` is set to `Monthly`, the format is `A-B`. Both A and B must be in the range 1–31, and B must be greater than or equal to A.

CascadingDeleteResources.description_cn:
Parameter deprecation notice:

* Only **existing users** can use this parameter. For criteria to determine existing users, see [FAQ](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6460/1182467).
* As this parameter will soon be discontinued, **existing users** can only use it within a specified timeframe. Please promptly update your interface and use the new **RetainResources** parameter. For interface update instructions, see [OpenAPI update instructions for cascading cluster resource deletion](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6460/1182467).
* **New users** (those who activated and started using VKE after December 18, 2023) should use the **RetainResources** parameter.

Synchronously delete related resources in the specified cluster. Options:

* **DefaultNodePoolResource**: Synchronously delete ECS instances in the default node pool of the cluster.
   If the default node pool contains subscription ECS instances, this interface only removes the ECS instances from the cluster without deleting them. You can find these instances in the [ECS console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) or via the [ECS API](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Elastic-Compute-Service-API-overview) and perform follow-up actions as needed.
* **NodePoolResource**: Synchronously delete all custom node pools in the cluster, ECS instances in the node pools, and their associated elastic block storage.
   Does not include storage resources corresponding to persistent volumes (PV), such as EBS, NAS file storage, vePFS file storage, object storage (TOS), etc.
* **Clb**: Synchronously delete load balancers (CLB) created by the cluster.
* **Nat**: Synchronously delete NAT gateways created by the cluster.
* **All**: Synchronously delete all the above resource types in the cluster, except for
   subscription nodes in the cluster, storage resources corresponding to PVs, and Topics associated with log services.

During deletion, resources with deletion protection enabled cannot be deleted. Resources without deletion protection will be deleted. Adjust deletion protection settings as needed before calling the interface.

RetainResources.description_cn:
* **Existing users** must complete the [API upgrade](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6460/1182467) before using this parameter. For how to determine existing users, see the [FAQ](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6460/1182467).
* **New users** (those who activated and used VKE after December 18, 2023) can use this parameter directly.

When deleting a cluster, specify which resources within the cluster to retain:

* Leave blank (default): Deletes all resources created in association with the cluster, as well as non-subscription ECS instances added to the node pool.
* **DefaultNodePoolResource**: Retains ECS instances in the default node pool and their associated Elastic Block Storage, public IPs, and other resources.
* **NodePoolResource**: Retains ECS instances in all custom node pools and their associated Elastic Block Storage, public IPs, and other resources.
* **Clb**: Retains load balancer (CLB) instances created by Ingress and Service within the cluster.
* **Alb**: Retains application load balancer (ALB) instances created by Ingress and Service within the cluster.
* **Nat**: Retains NAT gateways created in association with the cluster.
* **SecurityGroup**: Retains security groups created in association with the cluster.
* **All**: Retains all resources created in association with the cluster.

If deletion protection is enabled for these resources, they cannot be deleted. Resources without deletion protection will be deleted. Adjust deletion protection settings as needed before calling the API.

Node ID list
You can call the [ListNodes](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListNodes) API to obtain node IDs. You can specify up to 100 node IDs per request.
* Nodes must be in one of the following states:
   * `{Running,[*]}`
   * `{Stopped, [*]}`
   * `{Failed, [InitilizeFailed, NotReady, ResourceCleanupFailed, Balance, Unknown]}`
   You can call the [ListNodes](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListNodes) API to check the current status of nodes.
* When decommissioning [Elastic Bare Metal](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/General-purpose-EBM) nodes, ECS will attempt a normal shutdown based on the running status. If a normal shutdown fails, a forced shutdown will be performed. For more information, see [StopInstance](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/StopInstance).
* If the specified node pool has **AffinityGroupConfig** affinity group configuration (preview), you must ensure that after removing nodes from the pool, the remaining number of nodes is an integer multiple of the affinity group specification. You can also remove all nodes from the node pool.

Tags.Value.description_cn:
Single tag value, used to match a candidate value under the same tag key

* Only language characters, numbers, spaces, and special symbols `_ . : / = + - @` are allowed

Tags.Values.description_cn:

* Each tag value must meet the following requirements:

* Separate multiple tag values with a half-width comma (,)
* Can be empty
* After parameter values are provided, any cluster that matches any tag value in this list will be included in the results

Count.description_cn:

The upper limit for this parameter depends on the expected node count configuration of the node pool:

* The sum of the node pool's expected node count (`DesiredReplicas`) and the number of nodes to scale up (`Count`) must not exceed the node pool limit of 2000.
* If auto scaling is enabled for the node pool, the total number of nodes after scaling must not exceed the `MaxReplicas` parameter.
* For configuration methods of `DesiredReplicas` and `MaxReplicas`, see [CreateNodePool](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/CreateNodePool).

DefaultDeleteAllResources.description_cn:
Configure the global policy for cluster resource deletion OpenAPIs ([DeleteCluster](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/DeleteCluster), [DeleteNodePool](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/DeleteNodePool), [DeleteNodes](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/DeleteNodes), [DeleteAddon](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/DeleteAddon)). Change the default OpenAPI behavior to synchronously delete related resources to prevent resource remnants.

- **false**: Default value. When calling cluster resource deletion OpenAPIs, the legacy parameter **CascadingDeleteResources** is used. By default, this parameter retains all cluster-related resources and does not perform cascading deletion.
- **true**: When calling cluster resource deletion OpenAPIs, the new parameter **RetainResources** is used. By default, this parameter deletes all cluster-related resources to avoid unnecessary costs from leftover resources.

If you set this parameter to **true** and do not change it again within 30 days, the new parameter configuration policy will be considered accepted. Afterward, only the **RetainResources** parameter will be allowed in the above OpenAPI calls to specify which resources to retain during deletion.
DefaultDeleteAllResources.description_en:
Configure the global policy for cluster resource deletion OpenAPIs ([DeleteCluster](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/DeleteCluster), [DeleteNodePool](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/DeleteNodePool), [DeleteNodes](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/DeleteNodes), [DeleteAddon](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/DeleteAddon)). Change the default OpenAPI behavior to synchronously delete related resources to prevent resource remnants.

- **false**: Default value. When calling cluster resource deletion OpenAPIs, the legacy parameter **CascadingDeleteResources** is used. By default, this parameter retains all cluster-related resources and does not perform cascading deletion.
- **true**: When calling cluster resource deletion OpenAPIs, the new parameter **RetainResources** is used. By default, this parameter deletes all cluster-related resources to avoid unnecessary costs from leftover resources.

If you set this parameter to **true** and do not change it again within 30 days, the new parameter configuration policy will be considered accepted. Afterward, only the **RetainResources** parameter will be allowed in the above OpenAPI calls to specify which resources to retain during deletion.

LoggingConfig.LogProjectId.description_cn:
Cluster Log Project (Log Project) ID
* Cannot be an empty string
* When creating a cluster, if `LogProjectId` is not provided, the system will automatically create a new log project
* If the system automatically creates a log project, the project name is generated in the format `k8s-log-{clusterId}-{6 random characters}`
* If the `LogSetups.Enabled` field is set to `false`, the system will not automatically create a log project
* When updating cluster configuration, if `LogProjectId` has already specified a log project, it cannot be updated to empty
* When updating cluster configuration, if the cluster does not have any log configuration and only `LogProjectId` is provided while `LogSetups` is empty, `LogProjectId` will be ignored
* Updating `LogProjectId` will create a new topic for logs that are enabled

MaintenanceWindowConfig.Duration.description_cn:
Duration of automated O&M, integer value, valid range is 4–24, unit: hours.
If this parameter is not configured, the default value is 4.
MaintenanceWindowConfig.Duration.description_en:
Duration of automated O&M, integer value, valid range is 4–24, unit: hours.
If this parameter is not configured, the default value is 4.

MaintenanceWindowConfig.ExemptEndDate.description_cn:
End time of the automated O&M exemption window. Format: `YYYYMMDD`, based on Beijing time (UTC +8) calendar days. For example, if set to `20260704`, automated O&M tasks will not be performed up to and including 23:59:59 on that date.
This date must be later than the date configured for `ExemptStartDate` and cannot exceed 60 days.
MaintenanceWindowConfig.ExemptEndDate.description_en:
End time of the automated O&M exemption window. Format: `YYYYMMDD`, based on Beijing time (UTC +8) calendar days. For example, if set to `20260704`, automated O&M tasks will not be performed up to and including 23:59:59 on that date.
This date must be later than the date configured for `ExemptStartDate` and cannot exceed 60 days.

MaintenanceWindowConfig.ExemptStartDate.description_cn:
Start time of the automated O&M exemption window. Format: `YYYYMMDD`, based on Beijing time (UTC +8) calendar days. For example, if set to `20260702`, automated O&M tasks will not be performed starting from 00:00:00 on that date.
* This date must be earlier than the date configured for `ExemptEndDate` and cannot exceed 60 days.
* In scenarios such as critical business protection or network lockdown, you can configure the exemption window to disable automated O&M operations.
MaintenanceWindowConfig.ExemptStartDate.description_en:
Start time of the automated O&M exemption window. Format: `YYYYMMDD`, based on Beijing time (UTC +8) calendar days. For example, if set to `20260702`, automated O&M tasks will not be performed starting from 00:00:00 on that date.
* This date must be earlier than the date configured for `ExemptEndDate` and cannot exceed 60 days.
* In scenarios such as critical business protection or network lockdown, you can configure the exemption window to disable automated O&M operations.

MaintenanceWindowConfig.StartTime.description_cn:
Start time for automated O&M, Golang standard time format, 24-hour clock. Valid values are whole hours from 00 to 23. For example: 01:00:00Z, 14:00:00Z.
If this parameter is not configured, the default value is 16:00:00Z, which is 16:00 UTC and 00:00:00 the next day in Beijing time (UTC +8).
* This parameter currently only supports UTC standard time. If you need to use another time zone, manually convert the time to UTC standard time.
* The `ExemptStartDate` and `ExemptEndDate` parameters default to UTC +8 time zone. When configured together with this parameter, ensure time zone consistency.
MaintenanceWindowConfig.StartTime.description_en:
Start time for automated O&M, Golang standard time format, 24-hour clock. Valid values are whole hours from 00 to 23. For example: 01:00:00Z, 14:00:00Z.
If this parameter is not configured, the default value is 16:00:00Z, which is 16:00 UTC and 00:00:00 the next day in Beijing time (UTC +8).
* This parameter currently only supports UTC standard time. If you need to use another time zone, manually convert the time to UTC standard time.
* The `ExemptStartDate` and `ExemptEndDate` parameters default to UTC +8 time zone. When configured together with this parameter, ensure time zone consistency.

MaintenanceWindowConfig.TaskConfigs.description_cn:
Automated O&M task configuration.
If this parameter is not configured, the system only performs **routine cluster control plane O&M** tasks and does not perform other O&M tasks.
MaintenanceWindowConfig.TaskConfigs.description_en:
