AutoScaling.DesiredReplicas.description_cn:
Configure the desired number of nodes in the node pool. Value range: 0~2000.
When autoscaling is enabled for the node pool, **DesiredReplicas** must be greater than or equal to **MinReplicas** and less than or equal to **MaxReplicas**.
AutoScaling.DesiredReplicas.description_en:
Configure the desired number of nodes in the node pool. Value range: 0~2000.
When autoscaling is enabled for the node pool, **DesiredReplicas** must be greater than or equal to **MinReplicas** and less than or equal to **MaxReplicas**.

AutoScaling.Enabled.description_cn:
Configure the autoscaling switch for the node pool. Values:

* **false**: Off
* **true**: On
AutoScaling.Enabled.description_en:
Configure the autoscaling switch for the node pool. Values:

* **false**: Off
* **true**: On

AutoScaling.MaxReplicas.description_cn:
Configure the maximum number of nodes in the node pool. Value range: 1~2000.
This only takes effect for the node pool after autoscaling is enabled.
AutoScaling.MaxReplicas.description_en:
Configure the maximum number of nodes in the node pool. Value range: 1~2000.
This only takes effect for the node pool after autoscaling is enabled.

AutoScaling.MinReplicas.description_cn:
Configure the minimum number of nodes in the node pool. Value description:

* Minimum: 0
* Maximum: Less than the value of the **MaxReplicas** parameter

This only takes effect for the node pool after autoscaling is enabled.
AutoScaling.MinReplicas.description_en:
Configure the minimum number of nodes in the node pool. Value description:

* Minimum: 0
* Maximum: Less than the value of the **MaxReplicas** parameter

This only takes effect for the node pool after autoscaling is enabled.

AutoScaling.Priority.description_cn:
Priority. Value range: 0~100.
This only takes effect when autoscaling is enabled for the node pool and the scaling algorithm is set to `priority`.
AutoScaling.Priority.description_en:
Priority. Value range: 0~100.
This only takes effect when autoscaling is enabled for the node pool and the scaling algorithm is set to `priority`.

AutoScaling.SubnetPolicy.description_cn:
Multi-subnet scheduling policy for the node pool, used to schedule expansion of worker nodes according to subnet priority order. Values:

* **ZoneBalance**: Availability zone balancing policy. When scaling out nodes, new nodes are distributed across subnets in multiple availability zones to ensure the number of nodes in each zone remains relatively balanced.
* **Priority**: Subnet priority policy. Scheduling follows the order of the subnet list. If the highest-priority subnet can be created successfully, new nodes are always added to that subnet.
AutoScaling.SubnetPolicy.description_en:
Multi-subnet scheduling policy for the node pool, used to schedule expansion of worker nodes according to subnet priority order. Values:

* **ZoneBalance**: Availability zone balancing policy. When scaling out nodes, new nodes are distributed across subnets in multiple availability zones to ensure the number of nodes in each zone remains relatively balanced.
* **Priority**: Subnet priority policy. Scheduling follows the order of the subnet list. If the highest-priority subnet can be created successfully, new nodes are always added to that subnet.

ClientToken.description_cn: A string used to ensure request idempotency. The caller must provide this string and guarantee its uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters.

ClusterId.description_cn:

The cluster must be in the `{Running,[*]}` or `{Updating,[Progressing]}` state. You can call the [ListClusters](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListClusters) API to get the current status of the cluster.
ClusterId.description_en:

Id.description_cn: Node pool ID. You can obtain the node pool ID by calling the [ListNodePools](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListNodePools) API.  The node pool must be in the `{Running,[*]}` or `{Scaling,[Progressing]}` state. You can call the [ListNodePools](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListNodePools) API to obtain the current status of the node pool.
Id.description_en: Node pool ID. You can obtain the node pool ID by calling the [ListNodePools](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListNodePools) API. KubernetesConfig.AutoSyncDisabled.description_cn:

* **false**: Not disabled, automatic synchronization is turned on

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.Concur.description_cn:
Buffer size used for concurrent chunked pulling of a single image layer. Must be a positive integer, in bytes.
This parameter is supported only when containerd is version v2.1.0 or above.
KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.Concur.description_en:
Buffer size used for concurrent chunked pulling of a single image layer. Must be a positive integer, in bytes.
This parameter is supported only when containerd is version v2.1.0 or above.

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.MaxCon.description_cn:
Maximum number of image layers that containerd can download concurrently during a single image pull.

* Must be a positive integer; default is 3.
* If not configured, the system uses the default value.

This parameter is supported only when containerd is version v2.1.0 or above.
KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.MaxCon.description_en:
Maximum number of image layers that containerd can download concurrently during a single image pull.

* Must be a positive integer; default is 3.
* If not configured, the system uses the default value.

This parameter is supported only when containerd is version v2.1.0 or above.

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.MaxCon.description_cn:
Maximum number of image layers that containerd can decompress simultaneously.

* Must be a positive integer; default is 1.
* Takes effect only when `UseLocalImagePull` is set to `false`.

This parameter is supported only when containerd is version v2.2.0 or above.
KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.MaxCon.description_en:
Maximum number of image layers that containerd can decompress simultaneously.

* Must be a positive integer; default is 1.
* Takes effect only when `UseLocalImagePull` is set to `false`.

This parameter is supported only when containerd is version v2.2.0 or above.

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.UseLoc.description_cn:
Image pull mode for containerd. Values:

* **true** (default): Pull images using the local client.
* **false**: Pull images using the Transfer Service.

This parameter is supported only when containerd is version v2.1.0 or above.
KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.UseLoc.description_en:

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.TopologyM.description_cn:

* **restricted**: kubelet only accepts Pods that achieve optimal NUMA on requested resources

* **single-numa-node**: kubelet only allows Pods that achieve NUMA on CPU and device resources within the same node

NodeConfig.GpuDriverConfig.GpuDriverVers.description_cn:
Specify the GPU driver version to be installed on the node.

* You can call the [ListSupportedGpuDriverVersions](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListSupportedGpuDriverVersions) API to obtain the list of GPU driver versions supported by the image.
* If this parameter is left empty, the system will automatically fill in the recommended GPU driver version based on the GPU model.

If you specify multiple ECS instance types in the node pool, supported GPU drivers may differ between instance types. You must specify a GPU driver version supported by all selected instance types; otherwise, an error will occur.

* **false**: Do not automatically install the GPU driver.

This configuration does not take effect when the ECS instance is not a GPU model.

NodeConfig.HpcClusterIds.description_cn:
High Performance Computing Cluster ID

- When changing a node pool from **GPU Compute** to **High Performance Computing GPU**, you must specify a High Performance Computing Cluster ID. Get the ID from the **Instances & Images** > **High Performance Computing Cluster** page in the [Cloud Server Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs).

- Only one High Performance Computing Cluster ID is supported. For more information, see [High Performance Computing Cluster Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/gpu/HPC-cluster-overview).
- Make sure the specified High Performance Computing Cluster is in the same availability zone as the subnet specified in **SubnetIds**.


- When changing a node pool from **High Performance Computing GPU** to **GPU Compute**, you need to pass in an empty array to clear the existing High Performance Computing Cluster ID.

NodeConfig.InstanceChargeType.description_cn:
The billing type of ECS instances in the node pool. Options:

* **PostPaid**: Pay-as-you-go
* **PrePaid**: Yearly/Monthly Subscription

When switching between these two billing types, note the following:

* Node pools with the **Yearly/Monthly Subscription** type can be changed to **Pay-as-you-go** node pools
* Node pools with the **Pay-as-you-go** type can be changed to **Yearly/Monthly Subscription** node pools if all the following conditions are met:
   * Preemptible strategy is not enabled, i.e., `SpotStrategy` is set to `NoSpot`
   * Auto scaling is not enabled, i.e., `AutoScaling·Enabled` is `false`
   * Elastic reservation scaling rules are not enabled, i.e., calling the [ListScalingPolicies](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListScalingPolicies) API returns empty, or if not empty, `Enabled` is `false`

* When changing the node pool billing type from **Pay-as-you-go** to **Yearly/Monthly Subscription**, you must provide the **Period**, **AutoRenew**, and **AutoRenewPeriod** parameters
* After updating the billing type for nodes in the node pool, the change only applies to newly added nodes. For existing nodes, please go to the [Cloud Server Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) to modify manually
NodeConfig.InstanceChargeType.description_en:

* Node pools with the **Pay-as-you-go** type can be changed to **Yearly/Monthly Subscription** node pools if all the following conditions are met:
   * Preemptible strategy is not enabled, i.e., `SpotStrategy` is set to `NoSpot`
   * Auto scaling is not enabled, i.e., `AutoScaling·Enabled` is `false`
   * Elastic reservation scaling rules are not enabled, i.e., calling the [ListScalingPolicies](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListScalingPolicies) API returns empty, or if not empty, `Enabled` is `false`

* When changing the node pool billing type from **Pay-as-you-go** to **Yearly/Monthly Subscription**, you must provide the **Period**, **AutoRenew**, and **AutoRenewPeriod** parameters
* After updating the billing type for nodes in the node pool, the change only applies to newly added nodes. For existing nodes, please go to the [Cloud Server Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) to modify manually

NodeConfig.InstanceTypeIds.description_cn:
List of ECS instance specification IDs corresponding to the node. Passing parameter values updates the original specifications of the node pool. After updating, you can scale out using the new specifications; existing nodes with old specifications are not affected.
Call the [ListSupportedResourceTypes](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListSupportedResourceTypes) API to query the resource types and ranges supported by the cluster.
* Up to ten array elements are supported.
* When updating node pool specifications, GPU specifications can only be replaced with GPU specifications, and non-GPU specifications can only be replaced with non-GPU specifications.
* Specifications that are no longer available for sale in ECS cannot be used as replacements.

* **true**: Enabled. Before preemptible instances are about to be reclaimed, proactively create new preemptible instances for compensation.
* **false**: Disabled. Scale up to replenish the number of instances only after preemptible instances are reclaimed.

NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.BandwidthP.description_cn:

To obtain the shared bandwidth package ID, call the [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/bandwidthpackage/DescribeBandwidthPackages) API.

NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.BillingTyp.description_cn:

NodeConfig.Security.Login.Password.description_cn:
Root user login password, encoded in Base64.
Follow the cloud server requirements for instance passwords:

* Length must be 8–30 characters
* Cannot start with `/` or `$6$`
* Must include at least three of the following character types:
   * Lowercase letters `a`~`z`
   * Uppercase letters `A`~`Z`
   * Numbers `0`~`9`
   * Special characters `( ) ` ~ ! @ # $ % ^ & * _ - + = | { } [ ] : ; ' < > , . ? /`

NodeConfig.Security.SecurityGroupIds.description_cn:

* Must be in the same private network as the cluster
* If left empty, the **default cluster node security group** (named `<ClusterID>-common`) is used by default. For details about the default security group, see [Security group settings](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/Security-group-settings)
* Each node pool supports up to 5 associated security groups (including the default cluster node security group)

ScheduledInstancePolicy.AutoReleaseTime.description_cn:
Auto-release time for reserved instances, in UTC, accurate to the minute. When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Segmented` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – Time Segment), this is required and valid. Must be a 10-minute interval.

* If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve` (reservation delivery type), this time must be greater than reservation delivery +1 hour
* If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (immediate delivery type), the earliest release time is the next 10-minute interval after the current time. For example, if the current time is 5:02, the earliest auto-release time is 5:20
ScheduledInstancePolicy.AutoReleaseTime.description_en:
Auto-release time for reserved instances, in UTC, accurate to the minute. When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Segmented` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – Time Segment), this is required and valid. Must be a 10-minute interval.

* If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve` (reservation delivery type), this time must be greater than reservation delivery +1 hour
* If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (immediate delivery type), the earliest release time is the next 10-minute interval after the current time. For example, if the current time is 5:02, the earliest auto-release time is 5:20

ScheduledInstancePolicy.BestEffort.description_cn:
When the inventory of elastic scheduled instances cannot fully meet the reservation demand, choose whether to reserve as many instances as possible.

* **false:** Generate at most one reservation order
* **true:** If a single reservation order cannot meet the demand, multiple reservation orders will be submitted
ScheduledInstancePolicy.BestEffort.description_en:
When the inventory of elastic scheduled instances cannot fully meet the reservation demand, choose whether to reserve as many instances as possible.

* **false:** Generate at most one reservation order
* **true:** If a single reservation order cannot meet the demand, multiple reservation orders will be submitted

ScheduledInstancePolicy.DeliveryType.description_cn:
Delivery type for elastic scheduled instance - segmented type, options:

* **Reserve**: Scheduled delivery
* **Immediate**: Immediate delivery

Valid and required only when `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Segmented`, which means the instance is of the elastic scheduled - segmented type.
ScheduledInstancePolicy.DeliveryType.description_en:
Delivery type for elastic scheduled instance - segmented type, options:

* **Reserve**: Scheduled delivery
* **Immediate**: Immediate delivery

Valid and required only when `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Segmented`, which means the instance is of the elastic scheduled - segmented type.

ScheduledInstancePolicy.ElasticScheduled.description_cn:
Elastic scheduled instance type. Options:

* **Esi:** Elastic Scheduled Instance – General Purpose
* **Segmented:** Elastic Scheduled Instance – Time Segment
ScheduledInstancePolicy.ElasticScheduled.description_en:
Elastic scheduled instance type. Options:

* **Esi:** Elastic Scheduled Instance – General Purpose
* **Segmented:** Elastic Scheduled Instance – Time Segment

ScheduledInstancePolicy.EndDeliveryTime.description_cn:
Delivery end time for elastic scheduled instances, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Must be a 10-minute interval, and the interval with `StartDeliveryTime` must be 10 minutes. Options:

* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Esi` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – General Purpose), this is required and valid:
   * Value must be within 4–8 hours after the periodic task start time `LaunchTime`
* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Segmented` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – Time Segment):
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve` (reservation delivery type), this is required and valid. Value must be within 24 hours after the periodic task start time `LaunchTime`
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (immediate delivery type), this parameter does not need to be provided
ScheduledInstancePolicy.EndDeliveryTime.description_en:
Delivery end time for elastic scheduled instances, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Must be a 10-minute interval, and the interval with `StartDeliveryTime` must be 10 minutes. Options:

* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Esi` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – General Purpose), this is required and valid:
   * Value must be within 4–8 hours after the periodic task start time `LaunchTime`
* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Segmented` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – Time Segment):
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve` (reservation delivery type), this is required and valid. Value must be within 24 hours after the periodic task start time `LaunchTime`
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (immediate delivery type), this parameter does not need to be provided

ScheduledInstancePolicy.StartDeliveryTim.description_cn:
Delivery start time for elastic scheduled instances, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Must be a 10-minute interval. Options:

* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Esi` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – General Purpose), this is required and valid:
   * Value must be within 4–8 hours after the periodic task start time `LaunchTime`
* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Segmented` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – Time Segment):
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve` (reservation delivery type), this is required and valid. Value must be within 24 hours after the periodic task start time `LaunchTime`
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (immediate delivery type), this parameter does not need to be provided
ScheduledInstancePolicy.StartDeliveryTim.description_en:
Delivery start time for elastic scheduled instances, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Must be a 10-minute interval. Options:

* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Esi` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – General Purpose), this is required and valid:
   * Value must be within 4–8 hours after the periodic task start time `LaunchTime`
* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Segmented` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – Time Segment):
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve` (reservation delivery type), this is required and valid. Value must be within 24 hours after the periodic task start time `LaunchTime`
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (immediate delivery type), this parameter does not need to be provided

ScheduledPolicy.LaunchTime.description_cn:
Task start time, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Scheduled` or `Recurrence`.

* When `Type` is `Scheduled`, this is the trigger time for the scheduled task.
* When `Type` is `Recurrence`, this is the start time for the recurring task.
* Must be later than the current time, and only supports times within 90 days from creation or modification.

To ensure successful submission of the scheduled scaling request, it is recommended to set `LaunchTime` at least 1 minute later than the current time.
ScheduledPolicy.LaunchTime.description_en:
Task start time, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Scheduled` or `Recurrence`.

* When `Type` is `Scheduled`, this is the trigger time for the scheduled task.
* When `Type` is `Recurrence`, this is the start time for the recurring task.
* Must be later than the current time, and only supports times within 90 days from creation or modification.

To ensure successful submission of the scheduled scaling request, it is recommended to set `LaunchTime` at least 1 minute later than the current time.

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceEndTime.description_cn:
End time of the recurring task, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`.
Must be greater than or equal to `LaunchTime`, and only supports times within 365 days from creation or modification.
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceEndTime.description_en:
End time of the recurring task, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`.
Must be greater than or equal to `LaunchTime`, and only supports times within 365 days from creation or modification.

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType.description_cn:
Recurrence cycle of the recurring task. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`. Options:

* **Daily**: Executes once every N days.
* **Weekly**: Select specific days of the week to execute once per day.
* **Monthly**: Select specific dates within the month to execute once per day.
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType.description_en:
Recurrence cycle of the recurring task. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`. Options:

* **Daily**: Executes once every N days.
* **Weekly**: Select specific days of the week to execute once per day.
* **Monthly**: Select specific dates within the month to execute once per day.

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceValue.description_cn:
Number of times the recurring task is executed. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`.

* When `RecurrenceType` is `Daily`, only one value can be entered, ranging from 1 to 31.
* When `RecurrenceType` is `Weekly`, multiple values are supported, separated by commas. Values for Monday to Sunday are: 1,2,3,4,5,6,7.
* When `RecurrenceType` is `Monthly`, the format is `A-B`. Both A and B range from 1 to 31, and B must be greater than or equal to A.

NodePools.NodeIds.description_cn:
List of node IDs to be upgraded. You can call the [ListNodes](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListNodes) API to obtain node IDs. You can specify up to 2,000 node IDs per request.

* If you provide parameter values: upgrade will be performed at the node level, and only the specified nodes will be upgraded.
* If the parameter value is empty: upgrade will be performed at the node pool level, and all nodes in the specified node pool will be upgraded.

Nodes must be in the `{Running,[OK]}` state.
You can call the [ListNodes](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListNodes) API to get the current status of the nodes.
NodePools.NodeIds.description_en:

* If the parameter value is empty: upgrade will be performed at the node pool level, and all nodes in the specified node pool will be upgraded.

Nodes must be in the `{Running,[OK]}` state.
You can call the [ListNodes](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListNodes) API to get the current status of the nodes.

NodePools.NodePoolId.description_cn:
ID of the node pool where the nodes to be upgraded are located.
You can call the [ListNodePools](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListNodePools) API to obtain the node pool ID.
* The node pool must be in one of the following states:
   * `{Running,[*]}`
   * `{Scaling,[*]}`
* If nodes in the node pool are in the following states, their upgrade will be blocked. Nodes in other states will be upgraded.
   * `{Running,[Unschedulable]}`
   * `{Updating,[*]}`
   * `{Failed,[NotReady]}`
   * `{Failed,[Balance]}`

You can call the [ListNodePools](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListNodePools) API to get the node pool status, and call the [ListNodes](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vke/ListNodes) API to get the node status.

Password.description_cn:
Workspace BasicAuth password.

* Supports uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters. Must include at least three types of characters.
* Special characters include `!@#$%^*&()_+-=`.


* When calling this API, the original password must be Base64 encoded before entering it here. For example, if your original password is `admin@1234`, enter the Base64 encoded value here: `YWRtaW5AMTIzNA==`.
* Configure this parameter only when the `AuthType` is set to `BasicAuth`.

SecurityProtectionTypes.description_cn:
Security protection type for the public IP.

* Parameter - N: indicates the serial number of the security protection type. Currently, only 1 is supported.
* Values:
   * AntiDDoS_Enhanced: Apply for a public IP with enhanced protection, which can be added to a DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) instance.
            * If `SecurityProtectionTypes.N` is set to AntiDDoS_Enhanced, `BillingType` must be set to 2 or 3, and `ISP` must be set to BGP.
      * Enhanced protection public IP is currently in invite-only testing. To try it, please contact your account manager.
      
   * If not specified, a public IP with the default protection type will be requested.

SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_en:
Security protection type for public IP addresses
| Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the security protection type. Only the value 1 is currently supported. |

Values:
AntiDDoS_Enhanced: Apply for a public IP address with enhanced protection (can be added to a native DDoS protection instance)

If left blank, it means a public IP address with basic protection
Note: To set SecurityProtectionTypes.N to AntiDDoS_Enhanced, you must set BillingType to 2 or 3
This feature is currently in invite-only beta. To request access, please submit a ticket or contact your account manager

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Whether to enable managed mode. You can set this parameter only after enabling the NLB service. Available values:
- true: Yes. Use this value only when calling this API through the NLB service.
- false (default): No.
Note
The managed mode feature is currently in invitation-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager.

SpecificEgress.description_en:
Public IP egress. Only available when ISP imports BGP. You can specify this parameter. Available values:
- KUL: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
- MNL: Manila, Philippines
- SGN: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- BKK: Bangkok, Thailand
- TPE: Taipei, China
- LAX: Los Angeles, United States
- DFW: Dallas, United States
- IAD: Washington, United States

Tags.N.Key.description_en: Label key for public IP user tags. Parameter -N- indicates the sequence number of the label key, ranging from 1 to 50. N must be in consecutive ascending order. Separate multiple label keys with &. The key cannot start with volc: in any letter case. Length must be 1–128 characters. You can use letters from any language, numbers, spaces, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@). If there are spaces at the beginning or end of the label key, the system will automatically remove them. Note: Label keys for the same resource must be unique.

Tags.N.Value.description_en: Tag value (Value) for public IP user tags. Parameter - N - indicates the sequence number of the tag value (Value), ranging from 1 to 50. N must be in continuous ascending order. Separate multiple tag values (Value) with &. Length: 0–256 characters. If left blank, the default is empty. Supports all languages, numbers, spaces, underscores (_), periods (.), half-width colons (:), slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@). Case sensitive. Leading and trailing spaces in the tag value (Value) are automatically removed. Note: If you set this parameter, you must first set Tags.N.Key.

Tags.N.Key.description_en:

Ipv6Address.description_cn:
Specify private IPv6 addresses for the network interface.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the private IPv6 address. The value range depends on the network interface status.
   * When the network interface is in the Available state, the value range is 1~10.
   * When the network interface is in the InUse state, the value range for N is limited by the instance type. For more details, see [Instance Specifications](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Introduction-to-instance-types).
* Separate multiple private IPv6 addresses with &.
* The specified private IPv6 addresses must be available private IPv6 addresses within the subnet to which the network interface belongs.

You must provide either the `Ipv6Address.N` or `Ipv6AddressCount` parameter, but not both.

InstanceType.description_cn:

PrivateIpAddress.description_cn:
Private IP address of the instance to bind the public IP to.

* Only supports the private IP address of the primary network interface and the secondary network interface of ECS instances.
* If not specified: If `InstanceType` is EcsInstance, binds the primary private IP address of the primary network interface of the ECS instance. If `InstanceType` is NetworkInterface, binds the primary private IP address of the secondary network interface.

When binding a public IP to a high availability virtual IP, NAT gateway, or CLB load balancer, the `PrivateIpAddress` parameter is not supported.

ReleaseWithInstance.description_en:
Release public IP when cloud server instance is deleted
Only applies to pay-as-you-go public IPs. If enabled, when the cloud server instance is automatically reclaimed by the system (24 hours after unsubscription, upon expiration, or due to overdue payment) or deleted via the DeleteInstances API, the public IP will also be released.
- true: Yes
- false: No

Ipv6Isp.description_cn:
Line type. Valid values:

* BGP: BGP (multi-line)
* ChinaMobile: China Mobile static single line
* ChinaTelecom: China Telecom static single line
* ChinaUnicom: China Unicom static single line
* ChinaMobile_Value: China Mobile Value static single line
* ChinaUnicom_Value: China Unicom Value static single line
* ChinaTelecom_Value: China Telecom Value static single line
Ipv6Isp.description_en:

* BGP: BGP (multi-line)
* ChinaMobile: China Mobile static single line
* ChinaTelecom: China Telecom static single line
* ChinaUnicom: China Unicom static single line
* ChinaMobile_Value: China Mobile Value static single line
* ChinaUnicom_Value: China Unicom Value static single line
* ChinaTelecom_Value: China Telecom Value static single line

Ipv6MaskLen.description_cn:
Mask length.

* When Ipv6Isp is set to BGP, only 56 is supported; otherwise, this parameter supports 62-64.

* If the Ipv6Isp parameter is not BGP, either Ipv6MaskLen or Ipv6CidrBlock must be specified.

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range: 1–50.
* Separate multiple tag keys with &.
* Cannot start with `volc:` or `sys:`, in any case.
* Length range: 1–128 characters. Supports input of characters from any language, numbers, spaces ( ), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and @ (@).
* If the tag key starts or ends with a space, the system will automatically remove it.

> Tag keys for the same resource must not be duplicated.

Tags.N.Value.description_en:

* Case sensitive.
* If the tag value starts or ends with a space, the system will automatically remove it.

> If this parameter is provided, `Tags.N.Key` must be specified first.

Ipv6Address.description_cn:
Assign private IPv6 addresses to the network interface card.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the private IPv6 address. The value range depends on the NIC status.
   * When the NIC is in the 'Available' state, the value range is 1~10.
   * When the NIC is in the 'InUse' state, the value range for N is limited by the instance type. For more details, see [Instance Specifications](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Introduction-to-instance-types).
* Use & to separate multiple private IPv6 addresses.
* The specified IP must be an available IP in the subnet to which the NIC belongs.

* You cannot specify both `Ipv6Address.N` and `Ipv6AddressCount` at the same time.
* Assigning IPv6 addresses to NICs is currently in beta testing. Only accounts that have completed [Enterprise Certification](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6261/64937) can apply for a trial. To request a trial, please contact your account manager.

MacAddress.description_en:
MAC address of the network card. If not specified, the system will assign one by default. If you need to specify, the following constraints apply:

* Format requirements:
   * 48-bit address: Standard 12-digit hexadecimal number
   * Valid characters: Only `0-9`, `A-F`
* Must not conflict within the same region
* Must not conflict with MAC addresses reserved by Volcengine
* Must not conflict with other known communication addresses
* Broadcast address cannot be used: FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF
* Multicast address cannot be used

TcpClosedAndTimeWaitTimeout.description_cn:

* Value range: 3–15 seconds
* Default: 3 seconds

NextHopType.description_cn:
* **Subnet Route Table**: The next hop type for custom route entries. The available values are:
   * Instance: ECS instance
   * HaVip: High-availability virtual IP
   * NetworkInterface: Secondary network interface
   * NatGW: NAT gateway
   * VpnGW: VPN gateway
   * TransitRouter: Transit router
   * IPv6GW: IPv6 gateway
   * CloudConnector: Cloud connector
   * GWLBEndpoint: Gateway load balancer endpoint
* **Gateway Route Table**: The next hop type for custom route entries. The available values are:
   * NetworkInterface: Secondary network interface
   * GWLBEndpoint: Gateway load balancer endpoint

* Gateway load balancer, cloud connector, IPv6 gateway, and gateway route table are currently in invite-only testing. To request access, contact your account manager.
* Custom subnet route tables support specifying GWLBEndpoint. When the target CIDR block of GWLBEndpoint matches the local route's target CIDR block, the GWLBEndpoint route takes effect.
* If the NextHopType parameter of the gateway route table is set to GWLBEndpoint, the value of DestinationCidrBlock can be a subset of the subnet CIDR block, such as /32.

* The subnet's CIDR block cannot be the same as the destination CIDR block of any route entry in the VPC, but can be a subset of it.
* The subnet mask length depends on the VPC's CIDR block, as follows:

   * 172.16.XX.XX CIDR block mask range: 12–29
   * 192.168.XX.XX CIDR block mask range: 16–29

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Tag value (Value) for shared bandwidth package tags. For parameters in the format TagFilters.N.Values.N: The first N indicates the index of the tag value (Value) corresponding to the tag key (Key). This index must match the index of TagFilters.N.Key, ranging from 1 to 10, and should be in continuous ascending order. The second N indicates the index of the tag value (Value), ranging from 1 to 3.

You can omit Value to query without filtering by value.
If Value is an empty string, the query will return tags where the value is empty.
If you specify multiple TagFilters.N.Values.N for the same TagFilters.N.Key, these values are combined with a logical OR.
Note: You must specify TagFilters.N.Key before using this parameter.

TagFilters.N.Key.description_en: The tag keys that can filter results. They are used to restrict the output to only those Ipv6Gateways that have tags with the specified keys at the same time. \nThe key must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and the key pattern should be ^([\p{L}\p{Z}\p{N}_.:/=+-@]*)$ . \nValid values of N: 1 to 10.

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
The tag values that can filter results. They are used to restrict the output to only those Ipv6Gateways that have tags with any of the specified values. 
The value must be 0 to 256 characters in length, and the value pattern should be ^([\p{L}\p{Z}\p{N}_.:/=+-@]*)$ . 
Valid values of N: 1 to 10. 
Valid values of M: 1 to 3.

TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for the tag.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, value range: 1–10.
* Separate multiple tag keys with &. The relationship between multiple tag keys is logical "AND", that is, query network ACLs that have all specified tag keys.
* Duplicates are not allowed.

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Tag value for the tag.

* The first N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, value range: 1–10.
* The second N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, value range: 1–3. Multiple tag values under the same tag key are logically "OR", that is, query network ACLs that have any of the specified tag values under the same tag key.
* Separate multiple tag values with &.

* If this parameter is passed, you must first pass `TagFilters.N.Key`.
* Passing an empty string means querying network ACLs with empty tag values.

TcpClosedAndTimeWaitTimeout.description_cn:
Configure TCP connection close timeout. Sets the maximum wait time for the four-way handshake process when closing a TCP connection. If the handshake is not completed within the timeout, the connection is forcibly disconnected and session resources are released.
Value range: 3–15 seconds.
TcpClosedAndTimeWaitTimeout.description_en:
Configure TCP connection close timeout. Sets the maximum wait time for the four-way handshake process when closing a TCP connection. If the handshake is not completed within the timeout, the connection is forcibly disconnected and session resources are released.
Value range: 3–15 seconds.

TcpEstablishedTimeout.description_cn:
Configure TCP connection idle timeout. Sets the maximum retention time for a TCP connection without data transfer. When the timeout is reached, the connection is automatically disconnected and session resources are released.
Value range: 30–7200 seconds.
TcpEstablishedTimeout.description_en:
Configure TCP connection idle timeout. Sets the maximum retention time for a TCP connection without data transfer. When the timeout is reached, the connection is automatically disconnected and session resources are released.

TrafficMode.description_en:
Network interface communication mode

* HighPerformance: Enables RDMA communication mode
* Standard: Uses TCP communication mode

> The feature to enable RDMA communication mode for network interfaces is currently in invitation testing and only supports trial applications from accounts that have completed [Enterprise Certification](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6261/64937). To apply for a trial, please contact your account manager.

UdpTimeout.description_cn:
Configure UDP stream timeout. Sets the maximum idle retention time for a bidirectional UDP session without round-trip traffic. When the timeout is reached, the session is automatically deleted and resources are released.
Value range: 10–180 seconds.
UdpTimeout.description_en:

AddPrefixListEntries.N.Cidr.description_en:
CIDR to add as a prefix list entry.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the prefix list entry. Value range: 1 to `MaxEntries`, and N should be in continuous ascending order.
* Separate multiple CIDRs with &.

If the CIDR to be added already exists, only the value of `AddPrefixListEntries.N.Description` will be modified, i.e., only the description of the CIDR block will be updated.

AddPrefixListEntries.N.Description.description_en:

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the prefix list entry. Value range: 1 to `MaxEntries`, and N should be in continuous ascending order.

PacketLength.description_cn:
Packet size of the traffic mirror session. Minimum is 64 bytes. Recommended range: 64–1450 bytes. Default is 1500 bytes.
If the packet size is set ≤ the MTU value of the mirror source or > 1450, some packets will be truncated and the truncated content will be discarded. To ensure packets are not truncated, set the NIC MTU value as follows:
MTU of mirror source ≤ packet size set for the traffic mirror session ≤ MTU of mirror target - 50, and packet size set for the traffic mirror session ≤ 1450.

Ipv6CidrBlock.description_cn:

* After this parameter is provided, the Ipv6MaskLen parameter will not take effect.
* If the Ipv6Isp parameter is set to anything other than BGP, you must provide either the Ipv6MaskLen or Ipv6CidrBlock parameter.
* If the Ipv6Isp parameter is not provided or set to BGP and this parameter is not provided, the system will automatically assign an IPv6 CIDR block.

   * SGN: Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City)
   * BKK: Thailand (Bangkok)
   * TPE: China (Taipei)
   * LAX: United States (Los Angeles)
   * MEX: Mexico (Mexico City)
   * LON: United Kingdom (London)
   * MAD: Spain (Madrid)
   * FRA: Germany (Frankfurt)
   * MRS: France (Marseille)
   * MIL: Italy (Milan)
   * TYO: Japan (Tokyo)
   * SEL: South Korea (Seoul)
* When `Ipv6Isp` is set to `ChinaMobile_Value` or `ChinaUnicom_Value`, the values are:

   * HNZZ: Zhengzhou
   * HBLF_bytedance: Langfang
   * HBHL_bytedance: Huailai
   * JSNJ: Nanjing
   * GDSZ: Shenzhen
* When `Ipv6Isp` is set to `ChinaTelecom_Value`, the values are:

   * HNZZ: Zhengzhou
   * HBLF_bytedance: Langfang

> Langfang and Huailai public network gateways are currently in invitation testing. To apply for a trial, please contact your account manager.

SourceGroupId.description_cn:

You must specify one of the following parameters: `CidrIp`, `SourceGroupId`, or `PrefixListId`. If you specify more than one, only one takes effect in the following order of priority: `CidrIp` > `SourceGroupId` > `PrefixListId`.

SourcePortEnd.description_en:
Ending value of the source port range.

* When `Protocol` is `tcp` or `udp`, the valid range is `1` ~ `65535`.
* When `Protocol` is `icmp`, `icmpv6`, or `all`, only `-1` is supported, indicating no port restriction.

SourcePortStart.description_en:

* When `Protocol` is `tcp` or `udp`, the valid range is `1` ~ `65535`.
* When `Protocol` is `icmp`, `icmpv6`, or `all`, only `-1` is supported, indicating no port restriction.

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key (Key) for user tags.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key (Key). Value range: 1–20
* Use & to separate multiple tag keys (Key)
* Cannot start with `volc:` or `sys`, in any case
* Length range: 1–128 characters. Supports all languages, numbers, spaces ( ), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals (=), plus (+), hyphens (-), and @ (@)
* If there are spaces at the beginning or end of the tag key, the system will automatically remove them

Tag keys for the same resource cannot be duplicated

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value (Value) for user tags.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value (Value). Value range: 1–20
* Use & to separate multiple tag values (Value)
* Length range: 0–256 characters. If not specified, defaults to empty
* Supports all languages, numbers, spaces ( ), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals (=), plus (+), hyphens (-), and @ (@)
* Case sensitive
* If there are spaces at the beginning or end of the tag value (Value), the system will automatically remove them

If this parameter is passed, you must first pass `Tags.N.Key`

EgressAclEntries.N.Description.description_en:
Description for egress network ACL rules.

* Length limit: 0–255 characters
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. Can include English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
* If not specified, defaults to an empty string

EgressAclEntries.N.DestinationCidrIp.description_en:
Subnet of the destination address for egress network ACL rules.
When the parameter `UpdateEgressAclEntries` is set to "true", this parameter must be provided.

EgressAclEntries.N.NetworkAclEntryId.description_en:
Outbound rule ID for the Network ACL.
If the current outbound rule ID is provided, the new rule will continue to use this ID.

EgressAclEntries.N.NetworkAclEntryName.description_en:
Name of the outbound rule for the Network ACL.

* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number; can include period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-).
* If not specified, defaults to an empty string.

EgressAclEntries.N.Policy.description_en:
Authorization policy for egress network ACL rules. This determines whether resources within the subnet can access external resources. Possible values:

* accept (default): Allow access
* drop: Deny access

EgressAclEntries.N.Port.description_en:
Destination port range for the outbound rule of the Network ACL.

* When `IngressAclEntries.N.Protocol` is set to all, icmp, icmpv6, or gre:
   * This parameter is not required.
   * Default value is -1/-1, which means no port restriction.
* When `IngressAclEntries.N.Protocol` is set to tcp or udp:
   * This parameter is required.
   * Value range is 1–65535.
   * Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start and end ports, such as 1/50, 80/80.

EgressAclEntries.N.Protocol.description_en:
Protocol type for egress network ACL rules. Possible values:

* tcp: TCP protocol
* udp: UDP protocol
* icmp: ICMP protocol
* icmpv6: ICMPV6 protocol
* gre: GRE protocol
* all (default): Supports all protocols

IngressAclEntries.N.Description.description_en:
Description for ingress network ACL rules.

* Length limit: 0–255 characters
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. Can include English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
* If not specified, defaults to an empty string

IngressAclEntries.N.NetworkAclEntryId.description_en:
Inbound rule ID for the Network ACL.
If the current inbound rule ID is provided, the new rule will continue to use this ID.

IngressAclEntries.N.NetworkAclEntryName.description_en:
Name of the inbound rule for the Network ACL.

* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number; can include period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-).
* If not specified, defaults to an empty string.

IngressAclEntries.N.Policy.description_en:
Authorization policy for ingress network ACL rules. This determines whether external resources can access resources within the subnet. Possible values:

* accept (default): Allow access
* drop: Deny access

IngressAclEntries.N.Port.description_en:
Source port range for the inbound rule of the Network ACL.

* When `IngressAclEntries.N.Protocol` is set to all, icmp, icmpv6, or gre:
   * This parameter is not required.
   * Default value is -1/-1, which means no port restriction.
* When `IngressAclEntries.N.Protocol` is set to tcp or udp:
   * This parameter is required.
   * Value range is 1–65535.
   * Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start and end ports, such as 1/50, 80/80.

IngressAclEntries.N.Protocol.description_en:
Protocol type for the inbound rule of the Network ACL. Available values:

* tcp: TCP protocol.
* udp: UDP protocol.
* icmp: ICMP protocol.
* icmpv6: ICMPV6 protocol.
* gre: GRE protocol.
* all (default): Supports all protocols.

IngressAclEntries.N.SourceCidrIp.description_en:
Source address subnet for ingress network ACL rules.
When the parameter `UpdateIngressAclEntries` is set to "true", this parameter must be provided.

CidrBlock.description_cn:
Subnet CIDR block. The subnet CIDR block must be within the CIDR block of its associated VPC. The subnet CIDR block cannot be the same as the destination CIDR block of any route entry in the associated VPC, but it can be a subset of the destination CIDR block. The subnet mask length depends on the VPC CIDR block, as follows:
10.XX.XX.XX CIDR block mask range: 8 ~ 29
172.16.XX.XX CIDR block mask range: 12 ~ 29
192.168.XX.XX CIDR block mask range: 16 ~ 29

ClientToken.description_cn:

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, value range: 1–20
* Separate multiple tag keys with &. Naming rules are as follows:

* Can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

Tag keys for the same resource must not be duplicated

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
User gateway tag value (Value).

* Parameter - N: indicates the tag value sequence number, valid range: 1–20.
* Multiple tag values are separated by &. Naming rules:
* Can only contain language characters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols: '_', '.', ':', '/', '=', '+', '-', '@'.
* Can be empty; length limit is 0–256 characters.
* Case sensitive; cannot start or end with a space.

If you provide `Tags.N.Value`, you must also provide `Tags.N.Key`.

ClientIpPool.description_cn:
SSL client subnet. In SSL VPN, the client subnet is the address range assigned to the client's virtual network card, not the client's existing internal network subnet.

* Client subnet mask range: `/16`–`/28`.
* The client subnet cannot conflict with the `LocalSubnet` or IPSec connection routes.
* The client subnet cannot overlap with `100.64.0.0/10`, `169.254.0.0/16`, `127.0.0.0/8`, `224.0.0.0/4`, or `240.0.0.0/4`.
* The number of available IPs in the client subnet must be greater than four times the number of SSL connections selected when creating the VPN gateway. For example, if the SSL connection count is 10, the client subnet must have more than 40 available IPs.

* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

* group14

* aes256
* des
* 3des

IkeConfig.Lifetime.description_en: SA lifetime for IKE phase 1 negotiation in single tunnel mode IPsec connection. When the lifetime is exceeded, negotiation will be re-initiated. Value range: 900–86400, unit: seconds. Default: 86400.

IkeConfig.LocalId.description_en:
Identifier for the VPN gateway in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for IKE phase one negotiation in single-tunnel mode. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If not specified, defaults to the outbound IP address of the selected VPN gateway
* If you manually set it to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive"
* Maximum length is 100 characters; only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ; and numbers are allowed

IkeConfig.Mode.description_en:
Negotiation mode for IKE phase 1 in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections. This parameter is required only when IkeConfig.Version is **ikev1**. Possible values:

* main (default)
* aggressive

IkeConfig.Psk.description_en:
Pre-shared key for IKE in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for identity authentication between the VPN Gateway and the customer gateway in the first phase

* Maximum length is 100 characters
* Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are supported

IkeConfig.RemoteId.description_en:
Identifier for the user gateway in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for IKE phase 1 negotiation in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) formats.

* If not specified, defaults to the public IP address of the currently selected user gateway.
* If you manually set it to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive".
* Maximum length is 100 characters; only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ; and numbers are allowed.

IkeConfig.Version.description_en:
IKE key exchange protocol version for single tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* ikev1
* ikev2 (default)

IpsecConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm negotiated in IKE phase 2 for single tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* sha1 (default)
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

IpsecConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in IKE phase 2 for single tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* group1
* group2 (default)
* group5
* group14
* disable (do not configure DH algorithm)

> If you select group1, group2, group5, or group14, PFS (Perfect Forward Secrecy) will be enabled by default. The corresponding client must also enable PFS. If the client does not support PFS, set this option to "disable".

IpsecConfig.EncAlg.description_en:

* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

IpsecConfig.Lifetime.description_en: Lifetime of the SA negotiated in IKE phase 2 of single tunnel mode IPsec connections. After the lifetime expires, negotiation will restart. Range: 900–86400 seconds. Default: 86400.

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.LocalId.description_en:
Identifier for the IKE VPN gateway in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for IKE phase one negotiation in dual-tunnel mode. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If not specified, defaults to the outbound IP address of the selected VPN gateway
* If you manually set it to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive"
* Maximum length is 100 characters; only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ; and numbers are allowed

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.Mode.description_en:

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.Psk.description_en:

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.RemoteId.description_en:

* If not specified, defaults to the public IP address of the currently selected user gateway.

* Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

HealthCheckConfigs.N.CheckInterval.description_en:
Interval for performing health checks.

* Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the interval in the health check.
* Use `&` to separate multiple intervals.
* Value range: 1 to 300, default: 3, unit: seconds.

HealthCheckConfigs.N.DownTime.description_en:
Unhealthy threshold for health checks.

* Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the unhealthy threshold in the health check.
* Use `&` to separate multiple unhealthy thresholds.
* Value range: 1 to 10, default: 3, unit: times.

HealthCheckConfigs.N.LocalIp.description_en:
Source IP for health checks. The source IP refers to the IP address on the local VPC side that can be accessed from the local data center or peer VPC via IPsec connection.

* Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the source IP in the health check.
* Use `&` to separate multiple source IPs.
* IPs in the `169.254.0.0/16`, `224.0.0.0/3`, or `127.0.0.0/8` ranges are not supported.
* If multiple IPsec connections under the same VPN gateway need to enable health checks, please use different source IPs to distinguish them.

HealthCheckConfigs.N.RemoteIp.description_en:
Destination IP for health checks. The destination IP is the IP address of the peer data center or peer VPC that can be accessed from the local VPC via IPsec connection.

* Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the destination IP in the health check.
* Use `&` to separate multiple destination IPs.
* The destination IP cannot be the same as the source IP, and IPs in the `169.254.0.0/16`, `224.0.0.0/3`, or `127.0.0.0/8` ranges are not supported.

HealthCheckConfigs.N.Timeout.description_en:
Response timeout for health checks.

* Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the response timeout in the health check.
* Use `&` to separate multiple response timeouts.
* Value range: 1 to 300, and must be less than the value of `CheckInterval`. Default: 1, unit: seconds.
* Response timeout cannot be greater than the probe interval.

HealthCheckConfigs.N.UpTime.description_en:
Health threshold for health checks.

* Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the health threshold in the health check.
* Use `&` to separate multiple health thresholds.
* Value range: 1 to 10, default: 3, unit: times.

TagFilters.N.Values.M.description_en:
Tag value specified when querying resources by tag.

* The first N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range: 1–10.
* The second N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, range: 1–3. That is, each tag key supports querying up to 3 tag values at the same time.
* Multiple tag values are separated by &.
* If this parameter is passed, TagFilters.N.Key must be passed first.
* If only TagFilters.N.Key is passed without this parameter, it queries all tag values under the same tag key.
* Passing an empty string means querying tags with empty tag values.
* If multiple TagFilters.N.Values.N are passed for the same TagFilters.N.Key, the relationship between multiple TagFilters.N.Values.N is logical "or (OR)".

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Specify tag values when querying resources by tag

- The first N indicates the tag key index, ranging from 1 to 10
- The second N indicates the tag value index, ranging from 1 to 3. Each tag key supports querying up to 3 tag values at the same time
- Separate multiple tag values with `&`

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number. Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space ( ), underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。) are allowed.
* Length must be between 0 and 255 characters.
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration.

ClientIpPool.description_cn:
Client subnet.

* This subnet must not conflict with the `LocalSubnet` address range or any IPSec connection routes
* This subnet must not overlap with the local subnet, `100.64.0.0/10`, `169.254.0.0/16`, `224.0.0.0/3`, `127.0.0.0/8`, or `240.0.0.0/4`
* The number of IPs in the subnet mask must be greater than four times the SSL connection specification selected for the VPN gateway
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

BgpConfig.EnableBgp.description_en:
Whether to enable dynamic route propagation.

* false (default): No, use static routing mode.
* true: Yes, use BGP routing mode.
* Leave blank to keep the original configuration.

BgpConfig.LocalBgpIp.description_en:
Local tunnel IP, which is the BGP address configured on the VPN gateway

* Defaults to the first host address of `BgpConfig.TunnelCidr`.
* This address must be an IP address within the IPsec tunnel segment.
* If `BgpConfig.EnableBgp` is set to `true`, this parameter is required.
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration.

BgpConfig.TunnelCidr.description_en:
Tunnel subnet, which is the CIDR subnet containing the local and peer IPs for the BGP session.

* The subnet must be within `169.254.0.0/16`, have a subnet mask length of `/30`, and must not be within the `169.254.255.0/24` subnet.
* If `BgpConfig.EnableBgp` is set to `true`, this parameter is required.
* Leave blank to keep the existing configuration.

CustomerGatewayId.description_cn: ID of the user gateway associated with the IPsec connection. You can call [DescribeCustomerGateways](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpn/DescribeCustomerGateways) to query the user gateway ID. Leave blank to keep the current configuration
CustomerGatewayId.description_en: ID of the user gateway associated with the IPsec connection. You can call [DescribeCustomerGateways](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpn/DescribeCustomerGateways) to query the user gateway ID. Leave blank to keep the current configuration

DpdAction.description_cn:
Status of the DPD feature.

* none: Disable DPD
* clear (default): Enable DPD. If DPD times out, clear IKE SA
* hold: Enable DPD. If DPD times out, keep the current state and re-establish the connection when new traffic arrives
* restart: Enable DPD. If DPD times out, reconnect immediately

IkeConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for IKE phase 1 in single tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* sha1
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

IkeConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used for IKE phase 1 negotiation in single-tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* group1
* group2
* group5
* group14

IkeConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm for IKE phase 1 negotiation in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* aes
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

IkeConfig.Lifetime.description_en: SA lifetime for IKE phase 1 negotiation in single-tunnel mode IPsec connection. After the lifetime expires, negotiation will restart. Value range: 900~86400, unit: seconds.

IkeConfig.LocalId.description_en:
VPN gateway identifier in single-tunnel mode IPsec connection, used for phase 1 negotiation. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If you manually set to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to 'aggressive'.
* Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

IkeConfig.Mode.description_en:
Negotiation mode for phase one of IKE in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections. This parameter is required only when `IkeConfig.Version` is **ikev1**. Available values:

* main
* aggressive

If the user gateway IP address is `0.0.0.0`, only `aggressive` can be set for `IkeConfig.Mode`.

IkeConfig.Psk.description_en:
Pre-shared key for IKE in single tunnel mode IPsec connection, used for identity authentication between the VPN gateway and user gateway during the first phase.

* Maximum length: 100 characters.
* Only supports uppercase and lowercase English letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ; and numbers.

IkeConfig.RemoteId.description_en:
User gateway identifier in single-tunnel mode IPsec connection, used for phase 1 negotiation. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If you manually set to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to 'aggressive'.
* Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

IkeConfig.Version.description_en:
Version of the IKE key exchange protocol in single-tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* ikev1
* ikev2

If the user gateway IP address is `0.0.0.0`, only **`ikev1`** can be set for `IkeConfig.Version`.

IpsecConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for IKE phase 2 negotiation in single tunnel mode IPsec connection. Available values:

* sha1
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

IpsecConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in the second phase of IKE for single-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* group1
* group2
* group5
* group14
* disable (do not configure DH algorithm)

> If you select group1, group2, group5, or group14, PFS (Perfect Forward Secrecy) will be enabled by default. The corresponding client must also enable PFS. If the client does not support PFS, set this option to "disable".

IpsecConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm for IKE phase 2 negotiation in single-tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* aes
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

IpsecConfig.Lifetime.description_en:
Lifetime of the SA for IKE phase 2 negotiation in single tunnel mode IPsec connection. When the lifetime is exceeded, the system will re-initiate negotiation.

* Value range: 900~86400
* Unit: seconds.

LocalSubnet.description_cn:
Local subnet of the IPsec connection.

* Parameter - N indicates the sequence number of the local subnet.
* Up to 5 subnets are supported.
* Separate multiple subnets with &.
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

LogEnabled.description_cn:
Enable connection logs. After enabling connection logs, you can view and download IPsec connection logs, and use the log information to troubleshoot IPsec connection issues on your own.

* true: Enable
* false: Disable
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

Before enabling connection logs, make sure your account has activated the log service and object storage service, and has authorized VPN connection service to access the log service across services.

NegotiateInstantly.description_cn:
Whether to immediately initiate negotiation mode.

* true: The system will actively initiate negotiation as soon as the IPsec connection configuration is completed.
* false: The system will not actively initiate negotiation after the IPsec connection configuration is completed; negotiation will be initiated passively when traffic passes through.
* Leave blank to keep the original configuration.

If the user gateway IP address associated with the IPsec connection is `0.0.0.0`, only **false** can be entered here.
NegotiateInstantly.description_en:
Whether to immediately initiate negotiation mode.

* true: The system will actively initiate negotiation as soon as the IPsec connection configuration is completed.
* false: The system will not actively initiate negotiation after the IPsec connection configuration is completed; negotiation will be initiated passively when traffic passes through.
* Leave blank to keep the original configuration.

If the user gateway IP address associated with the IPsec connection is `0.0.0.0`, only **false** can be entered here.

RemoteSubnet.description_cn:
Peer network segment of the IPsec connection.

* Parameter - N indicates the sequence number of the peer network segment.
* Supports up to 5 network segments.
* Separate multiple segments with &.
RemoteSubnet.description_en:

Spec.description_cn:
IPsec connection instance specification. Only IPsec associated with TR instances takes effect; IPsec associated with VPN gateway instances is invalid. Leave blank to keep the default configuration.

* default: Default specification, bandwidth up to 200 Mbps.
* large: Large specification, bandwidth up to 1 Gbps.
* xlarge: Extra large specification, bandwidth up to 3 Gbps.

Large and extra large specifications are currently in invitation-only testing. They are available only after activation. To request a trial, contact your account manager.

Large and extra large specifications are currently in invitation-only testing. They are available only after activation. To request a trial, contact your account manager.

TunnelOptions.N.BGPConfig.LocalBgpIP.description_en:
BGP address on the BytePlus side.

* This address must be an IP address within the IPsec tunnel subnet.
* If EnableTunnelsBgp is set to true, this parameter is required.

TunnelOptions.N.BGPConfig.LocalBgpIp.description_en:
BGP address on the BytePlus side
- Defaults to the first host address of TunnelOptions.N.BGPConfig.TunnelCidr
- This address must be an IP within the IPsec tunnel subnet
- If EnableTunnelsBgp is set to true, this parameter is required

TunnelOptions.N.BGPConfig.TunnelCidr.description_en:
CIDR subnet containing the local and peer IPs for the BGP session.

* The subnet must be within 169.254.0.0/16 with a subnet mask length of 30.
* If EnableTunnelsBgp is set to true, this parameter is required.

TunnelOptions.N.CustomerGatewayId.description_en:
ID of the user gateway associated with the dual tunnel. If the user gateway IP address is 0.0.0.0, only **false** can be set for NegotiateInstantly, only **ikev1** can be set for IkeConfig.Version, and only **aggressive** can be set for IkeConfig.Mode.
This parameter is required when creating a dual tunnel type IPsec connection.

TunnelOptions.N.DpdAction.description_en:
DPD function status.

* none: DPD function disabled.
* clear: DPD function enabled; clears IKE SA after DPD timeout.
* hold: DPD function enabled; keeps current state after DPD timeout and re-establishes connection when new traffic arrives.
* restart: DPD function enabled; reconnects immediately after DPD timeout.

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for IKE phase 1 in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* sha1
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in IKE phase 1 negotiation for dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* group1
* group2
* group5
* group14

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm for IKE phase 1 negotiation in dual tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* aes
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.Lifetime.description_en: Lifetime of the SA negotiated in IKE phase 1 for dual tunnel mode IPsec connection. After the lifetime expires, negotiation will restart. Value range: 900~86400, unit: seconds.

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.LocalId.description_en:
Identifier of the VPN gateway in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for phase 1 negotiation. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If you manually set FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive"
* Maximum length is 100 characters; only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.Mode.description_en:
Negotiation mode for IKE phase 1 in dual tunnel mode IPsec connection. This parameter is required only when `IkeConfig.Version` is **ikev1**. Options:

* main
* aggressive

If the user gateway IP address is `0.0.0.0`, only `aggressive` can be set for `IkeConfig.Mode`.

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.Psk.description_en: Pre-shared key for IKE in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for identity authentication between the VPN gateway and the user gateway in phase 1. Maximum length is 100 characters; only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.RemoteId.description_en:
User gateway identifier in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for phase one negotiation. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If you manually set it to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive".
* Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.Version.description_en:
Version of the IKE key exchange protocol in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* ikev1
* ikev2

If the user gateway IP address is `0.0.0.0`, only **`ikev1`** can be set for `IkeConfig.Version`.

TunnelOptions.N.IpsecConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for IKE phase 2 negotiation in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* sha1
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

TunnelOptions.N.IpsecConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in the second phase of IKE for dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* group1
* group2
* group5
* group14
* disable (do not configure DH algorithm)

> If you select group1, group2, group5, or group14, PFS (Perfect Forward Secrecy) will be enabled by default. The corresponding client must also enable PFS. If the client does not support PFS, set this option to "disable".

TunnelOptions.N.IpsecConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm for IKE phase 2 negotiation in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

TunnelOptions.N.IpsecConfig.Lifetime.description_en: Lifetime of the SA negotiated in IKE phase 2 for dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections. After the lifetime expires, negotiation will restart. Value range: 900–86400 seconds. Default: 86400.

TunnelOptions.N.NatTraversal.description_en:
Enable NAT traversal.

* true: Enable. When NAT Traversal is enabled, IKE negotiation does not verify UDP port numbers and can detect NAT gateway devices in the VPN tunnel.
* false: Disable.

TunnelOptions.N.TunnelId.description_en: ID of the dual tunnel connection.

ClientToken.description_cn:
Client token, used to ensure request idempotency

* The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure uniqueness between different requests, avoiding repeated operations caused by multiple retries when the API call times out or a server error occurs
* Only ASCII characters are supported, and cannot exceed 64 characters
* If ClientToken is not provided, this API call will not perform idempotency verification

HealthCheckConfigs.N.CheckInterval.description_en: Health check interval; range: 3–300 seconds; default: 3 seconds

HealthCheckConfigs.N.DownTime.description_en: Unhealthy threshold for health checks. If a target IP returns 'abnormal' for all of the specified number of consecutive health checks, it will be considered to have a health check abnormality. Range: 1 to 10; default: 3; unit: occurrences

HealthCheckConfigs.N.Timeout.description_en: Health check response timeout. If the target IP does not respond correctly within the specified time, the health check is marked as abnormal. Valid range: 1–300 seconds, must be less than CheckInterval. Default: 1 second.

HealthCheckConfigs.N.UpTime.description_en: Health check threshold. If a target IP receives 'normal' status for the specified number of consecutive health checks, it is considered normal in the health check. Range: 1–10; default: 3; unit: checks

LocalIp.description_cn:
Source IP for health check

* IPs in the `169.254.0.0/16`, `224.0.0.0/3`, or `127.0.0.0/8` ranges are not supported
* If multiple IPsec connections under the same VPN gateway require health checks, use different source IPs to distinguish them
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration
LocalIp.description_en:
Source IP for health check

* IPs in the `169.254.0.0/16`, `224.0.0.0/3`, or `127.0.0.0/8` ranges are not supported
* If multiple IPsec connections under the same VPN gateway require health checks, use different source IPs to distinguish them
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

RemoteIp.description_cn:
Destination IP for health check

* The destination IP cannot be the same as the source IP. IPs in the `169.254.0.0/16`, `224.0.0.0/3`, or `127.0.0.0/8` ranges are not supported
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration
RemoteIp.description_en:
Destination IP for health check

* The destination IP cannot be the same as the source IP. IPs in the `169.254.0.0/16`, `224.0.0.0/3`, or `127.0.0.0/8` ranges are not supported
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

Timeout.description_cn:
Response timeout for health check. If the IPsec connection does not respond correctly within the specified time, the health check is considered "abnormal"

* Value range: 1 to 300, must be less than the value of `CheckInterval`. Unit: seconds
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration
Timeout.description_en:
Response timeout for health check. If the IPsec connection does not respond correctly within the specified time, the health check is considered "abnormal"

* Value range: 1 to 300, must be less than the value of `CheckInterval`. Unit: seconds

UpTime.description_cn:
Healthy threshold for health check

* Value range: 1 to 10, unit: times
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration
UpTime.description_en:
Healthy threshold for health check

* Value range: 1 to 10, unit: times
