BGPConfig.LocalBgpIP.description_en:
BGP address on the BytePlus side.

* This address must be an IP address within the IPsec tunnel subnet.
* If EnableTunnelsBgp is set to true, this parameter is required.

BGPConfig.LocalBgpIp.description_en:
BGP address on the BytePlus side
- Defaults to the first host address in TunnelOptions.N.BGPConfig.TunnelCidr
- The address must be an IP address within the IPsec tunnel subnet

BGPConfig.TunnelCidr.description_en:
CIDR block containing the local and remote IPs of the BGP session.

* The CIDR block must be within 169.254.0.0/16 and have a subnet mask length of 30.
* If EnableTunnelsBgp is set to true, this parameter is required.

CustomerGatewayId.description_cn:
ID of the customer gateway associated with the tunnel. If the IP address of the customer gateway is 0.0.0.0, NegotiateInstantly can only be set to **false**, IkeConfig.Version can only be **ikev1**, and IkeConfig.Mode can only be **aggressive**.
This parameter is required when creating a dual-tunnel IPsec connection.
CustomerGatewayId.description_en:
ID of the customer gateway associated with the tunnel. If the IP address of the customer gateway is 0.0.0.0, NegotiateInstantly can only be set to **false**, IkeConfig.Version can only be **ikev1**, and IkeConfig.Mode can only be **aggressive**.
This parameter is required when creating a dual-tunnel IPsec connection.

DpdAction.description_cn:
Status of the DPD feature.

* none: DPD is disabled
* clear: DPD is enabled; IKE SA is cleared after DPD timeout
* hold: DPD is enabled; current state is maintained after DPD timeout, and connection is re-established when new traffic arrives
* restart: DPD is enabled; reconnect immediately after DPD timeout
DpdAction.description_en:
Status of the DPD feature.

* none: DPD is disabled
* clear: DPD is enabled; IKE SA is cleared after DPD timeout
* hold: DPD is enabled; current state is maintained after DPD timeout, and connection is re-established when new traffic arrives
* restart: DPD is enabled; reconnect immediately after DPD timeout

DpdMode.description_cn:
Specifies the dpd mode.
Enums: on_demand, periodic.
Default: on_demand
DpdMode.description_en:
Specifies the dpd mode.
Enums: on_demand, periodic.
Default: on_demand

IkeConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for phase 1. Available values:

* sha1
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

IkeConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in phase 1 negotiation. Options:

* group1
* group2
* group5
* group14

IkeConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm for phase 1 negotiation. Options:

* aes
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

IkeConfig.Lifetime.description_en:
SA lifetime for phase 1 negotiation. When the lifetime is exceeded, negotiation restarts.

* Range: 900–86400 seconds
* Default: 86400

IkeConfig.LocalId.description_en:
Identifier for the VPN gateway, used in phase 1 negotiation. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If not specified, defaults to the egress IP address of the selected VPN gateway.
* If you manually set to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive".
* Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

IkeConfig.Mode.description_en:
Negotiation mode for phase 1. This parameter is required only when IkeConfig.Version is **ikev1**. Options:

* main
* aggressive

IkeConfig.Psk.description_en: Pre-shared key used for identity authentication between the VPN gateway and user gateway in phase one. Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special characters ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

IkeConfig.RemoteId.description_en:
Identifier for the customer gateway, used in phase 1 negotiation. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If not specified, defaults to the public IP address of the selected customer gateway.
* If you manually set to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive".
* Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

IkeConfig.Version.description_en:
Version of the IKE key exchange protocol. Options:

* ikev1
* ikev2

IpsecConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for phase 2 negotiation. Options:

* sha1
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

IpsecConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in phase 2. Available values:

* group1
* group2
* group5
* group14
* disable (do not configure DH algorithm)

> If you select group1, group2, group5, or group14, PFS (Perfect Forward Secrecy) will be enabled by default. The corresponding client must also enable PFS. If the client does not support PFS, set this option to "disable".

IpsecConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm negotiated in phase 2. Available values:

* aes
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

IpsecConfig.Lifetime.description_en:
SA lifetime for phase 2 negotiation. When the lifetime is exceeded, negotiation restarts.

* Range: 900–86400
* Unit: seconds
* Default: 86400

NatTraversal.description_cn:
Enable NAT traversal.

* true: Enable. When NAT traversal is enabled, IKE negotiation does not verify UDP port numbers and can detect NAT gateway devices in the VPN tunnel.
* false: Disable
NatTraversal.description_en:
Enable NAT traversal.

* false: Disable

Asn.description_cn:
ASN of the VPN gateway. Only supports initial configuration of ASN. If the VPN gateway has not been configured with an ASN, you can set the ASN using this parameter. If the VPN gateway already has an ASN configured, modification is not allowed.

* Valid range for VPN gateway ASN: 64512–65534, 4200000000–4294967294
* If left blank, the original configuration will be retained
Asn.description_en:

* If left blank, the original configuration will be retained

Bandwidth.description_cn:
Bandwidth specification of the VPN gateway instance, unit: Mbps.

* Leave blank to keep the current configuration.
* Valid values: 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 1000, 3000.

VPN gateways with 1000 Mbps and 3000 Mbps bandwidth specifications are available by invitation only. Only users who have enabled these specifications can use them. If you have not enabled these specifications, please avoid specifying `Bandwidth`. If needed, contact your account manager to apply for a trial.

* Length limit: 0 to 255 characters.
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration.

* false: Disable

ClientToken.description_cn:
Client token, used to ensure request idempotency.

* The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure uniqueness across different requests, preventing duplicate operations caused by multiple retries when API calls time out or internal server errors occur.
* Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value cannot exceed 64 characters.
* If ClientToken is not provided, idempotency validation will not be performed for this API call.

AccurateGroup.description_en: Advanced conditions. No need to provide if not configured.

AccurateGroupPriority.description_en: Priority of advanced conditions. When displaying the list, you can use this value to determine the target position for drag-and-drop. No need to set this when creating or updating.

ActionAfterVerification.description_en:
Follow-up action after successful challenge verification. Only effective when `ActionType` is `6` (JS challenge), `7` (CAPTCHA), or `10` (proof of work). Supported values are:

* `1`: Block
* `2`: Observe

ActionType.description_en:
Action to execute. Supported values are:

* `0`: Observe
* `1`: Rate limit (supported only in frequency limit scenarios, i.e., when `StatisticalType=1`)
* `2`: Block
* `6`: JS challenge
* `7`: CAPTCHA
* `10`: Proof of work
* `11`: Drop

EffectTime.description_en:
Action duration in seconds. Valid range: 30–86400 seconds.
Required when creating or updating a rule, except when `ActionType` is `1` (rate limiting).

Enable.description_en:
Enable status. Supported values are:

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

ExemptionTime.description_en:
Exemption time for CAPTCHA, JS challenge, or proof of work, in seconds. Valid range: 30–3600 seconds.
Required only when `ActionType` is one of the following:

* `6`: JS challenge
* `7`: CAPTCHA
* `10`: Proof of work

Field.description_en:
Statistical objects for the rule. Supports single or multiple fields, separated by commas (up to 10). Combine multiple statistical objects with commas, no spaces.
Field formats are divided into two types: enumerated values without keys and enumerated values with keys.

* Enumerated values without keys include:
   * `CLIENTIP`: Client IP (supported only when `StatisticalType=1`)
   * `JA3HASH`: JA3 hash value (applicable only in byteplus-global region)
* Enumerated values with keys include:
   * `HEADER:{Header-Name}`: Specify request header (e.g., `HEADER:X-Forwarded-For`)
   * `ARGS:{ArgName}`: Specify request parameter (e.g., `ARGS:device_id`)
   * `COOKIE:{CookieName}`: Specify cookie (e.g., `COOKIE:token`)

Host.description_en: Domain name of the website to be protected.

Name.description_en:
Rule Name

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number
* Letters, numbers, Chinese characters, dot '.', underscore '_', and hyphen '-' are allowed
* Length must be 1–128 characters

Path.description_en: Specify the request path to which the rule applies. You can enter a specific page path, or match all paths on the site or within a directory (using the wildcard *). The wildcard `*` can only appear at the end of the path.

PathThreshold.description_en: Total access threshold for the current path. Effective only when the statistical type is frequency limit (`StatisticalType=1`). Value range: 1–1000 occurrences.

ProjectName.description_en: Name of the project resource. For how to obtain, refer to [ListProjectResources - Get project resource list](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6649/1131874).

RulePriority.description_en: Rule execution priority under the same path and advanced condition. Value range: 0–9. Priorities cannot be duplicated between different rules. To query available priorities, call [ListBotAnalyseProtectRulePriorityAvailable - Query available bot statistical protection rule priorities](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/waf/ListBotAnalyseProtectRulePriorityAvailable).

SingleProportion.description_en: Proportion threshold for a single statistical object. Enabled only when `StatisticalType` is `3` (duplicate proportion); you must provide this field in this case. Value range: `[0, 1)`.

SingleThreshold.description_en: Threshold for the number of times per statistical object, in occurrences. Used only when the statistical type is frequency limit (`StatisticalType=1`). Value range: 1–1000 occurrences.

StatisticalDuration.description_en:
Statistical time window, in seconds. Value ranges vary by scenario:

* Frequency limit scenario (`StatisticalType=1`): 5–1800 seconds
* Duplicate statistics scenario (`StatisticalType=2` or `StatisticalType=3`): 1–60 seconds

StatisticalType.description_en:
Statistical type. Supported values:

* `1`: Access frequency
* `2`: Repeat count
* `3`: Repeat ratio

AccurateGroup.description_en:
Advanced conditions. This field is not required if not configured.
The current path URL and AccurateGroup have an AND relationship; the rule takes effect only when both are matched.
In CreateCCRule and UpdateCCRule, do not pass this field if advanced conditions are not enabled or the advanced condition list is empty. If advanced conditions are enabled, you must pass Logic and at least one valid AccurateRules.

AccurateGroupPriority.description_en: Advanced condition priority. Not required for create/update; used only for list display and priority adjustment.

CCType.description_en:
Action:
- 0: Observe
- 1: Rate-limit
- 2: Block
- 6: JS challenge
- 7: Captcha

CountTime.description_en: Statistics time window, in seconds. The range in external documentation is 5~1800.

CronConfs.description_en:
Scheduled activation configuration list. Array elements are CronConf, thresholds switch according to crontab.
Required only when CronEnable=1.

CronEnable.description_en: Scheduled activation switch, default is 0, meaning the rule is always active: - 0: Off - 1: On. When enabled, CronConfs must also be configured.

CustomResponsePageID.description_en: Custom response page ID; an empty string means not configured. This extended field is not detailed in the current public documentation. Before use, ensure the user has enabled and is authorized to use the corresponding custom response page.

EffectTime.description_en: Action duration, in seconds, range: 1~86400. When the action is rate limiting, blocking, CAPTCHA, or JS challenge, it is recommended to specify explicitly.

ExemptionTime.description_en: Exemption time for CAPTCHA or JS challenge, in seconds, range: 1~3600. Users can access normally after passing verification within the exemption period. If the exemption period ends but the restriction duration continues, verification will be triggered again.

Field.description_en: Statistics object. Supports single or multiple fields, separated by commas, up to 10 fields. The basic format in external documentation is DataType:Value. For example: HEADER:Authorization/COOKIE:PHPSESSID/ARGS:device_id/CLIENTIP. The current code also supports extended statistics objects such as JA3HASH, SESSION-ID, and FP. Optional values: - CLIENTIP: Source IP - HEADER:{Header-Name}: Specific request header. Header-Name must comply with HTTP header key specifications - ARGS:{ArgName}: Specific request parameter - COOKIE:{CookieName}: Specific cookie - JA3HASH: JA3 Hash - SESSION-ID: Session ID (available only for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true) - FP: Client fingerprint (available only for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true)

Host.description_en:
Domain name.
Website domain to be protected. Before calling, ensure the domain has been added to the current WAF instance.

Name.description_en: Rule name. Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number. Allows Chinese characters, letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Length: 1~128 characters.

PathThreshold.description_en:
Overall threshold for the current path.
The value range in external documentation is 1–300000, unit: times.

ProjectName.description_en: Project name refers to the project associated with the current resource. You can only link projects under your current identity that you have permission to access. To get a project name, use ListProjectResources to get the project resource list, or call CreateProject to create a new project.

RulePriority.description_en: Rule priority: value range 0–9; 0 is the highest priority, 9 is the lowest priority.

RuleTag.description_en:
Rule display ID. Not included in create/update, used only for list display.
The RuleTag prefix for CC rules is always E, for example, E000000003624.

SingleThreshold.description_en: Threshold for a single statistics object. The range in external documentation is 1~300000, unit: times.

Url.description_en:
Request path.
You can specify a specific page path, match the entire site, or all paths under a directory. The wildcard * can only appear at the end of the path.
For example: /test.html, /*, /test/*.

WSCdnByteThreshold.description_en: WebSocket byte threshold. Range: 1~10000000; 0 means not configured.

WSCdnEnable.description_en: WebSocket statistics protection switch: - 0: Off - 1: On. When enabled, you must configure at least one of WSCdnFrameThreshold or WSCdnByteThreshold. Cron scheduling is not supported when enabled.

WSCdnFrameThreshold.description_en: WebSocket frame threshold. Range: 1~10000; 0 means not configured.

WSCdnUnit.description_en: WebSocket byte threshold units: - KB: KiB - MB: MiB - GB: GiB

Perform action.

- js: JS challenge

- pow: Proof of work
- permit: Permit

RedirectUrl.description_en: Target URL for redirect page mode

AccessMode.description_en:
Access mode; different access parameters are required accordingly.

* 10: CNAME access
* 11: Layer 7 Load Balancer (CLB) listener access
* 20: Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance access

BackendGroups.description_en: Origin configuration details. Only required for **CNAME access**.

CertificateID.description_en: [Not currently displayed] Certificate ID. Only required for **CNAME access** and when **protocol type includes HTTPS**. You can obtain the certificate ID via [ListWafServiceCertificate - View certificate details](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/waf/ListWafServiceCertificate).

CertificatePlatform.description_en: Certificate management platform. WAF certificates are centrally managed in the BytePlus Certificate Center. Default value is `certificate_service`. Only required for **CNAME access** and when **protocol type includes HTTPS**.

ClientIPLocation.description_en:
Client IP acquisition method, used to specify how the WAF instance obtains the real IP address of the client. You need to configure this when your service uses a proxy (`ProxyConfig=1`).

* `0`: Obtain via custom header field; you need to specify the `CustomHeader`.
* `1`: Obtain via the first public IP address in the `X-Forwarded-For` (XFF) field.

ClientMaxBodySize.description_en: Maximum client request body size. Used to limit the size of data uploaded by clients. Required only when using **CNAME access**. Supports `1-10240` MB, default is `60` MB.

CloudAccessConfig.description_en: Load balancing access parameter configuration. Required only for **application load balancing (ALB) access or load balancing (CLB) Layer 7 access**. Used to specify parameters for WAF instance access via load balancing. Supports configuring multiple load balancing instances.

CustomHeader.description_en:
Custom header field list, used to specify custom HTTP header information added by the WAF instance when forwarding requests.

* Required when the client IP acquisition method is custom header field, i.e., `ClientIPLocation=0`.
* Supports up to 5 custom headers.

CustomSNI.description_en:
Custom SNI. Only required for **CNAME access** and when SNI is enabled (`EnableSNI=1`).

* If your origin IP is bound to multiple domain names and WAF accesses your origin via HTTPS, you need to configure origin SNI (Server Name Indication) to specify the exact domain name for the request. The origin returns the corresponding SSL certificate based on the configured SNI name to ensure proper origin access.
* If no domain name is configured, origin access is based on the actual host in the traffic.

Domain.description_en: Domain information to be protected. Supports wildcard and exact domains.

EnableCustomRedirect.description_en:
Enable forced redirection for non-standard ports. Required only for **CNAME access** and when the **protocol type includes HTTPS**. Default is 0 (disabled).

* 0: Disable forced redirection
* 1: Enable forced redirection

When enabled, if users access via a non-standard HTTPS port, WAF automatically redirects requests to the standard HTTPS port (443).

EnableHTTP2.description_en:
Enable HTTP 2.0. Only required for **CNAME access**. Default is 0 (disabled).

* 0: Disabled
* 1: Enabled

EnableIPv6.description_en:
Enable IPv6 support. Required only when using **CNAME access**. Default is 0 (disabled).

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

EnableSNI.description_en:
Enable SNI (Server Name Indication) configuration to specify the requested domain name during HTTPS origin pull. Only required for **CNAME access**. Default is `0` (disabled).

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

When enabled, you must specify the origin domain in the `CustomSNI` field.

KeepAliveRequest.description_en: Number of persistent connection reuses. Specifies how many requests the WAF instance can reuse over persistent connections when pulling from the origin. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports `60-1000`, default is `100`.

KeepAliveTimeOut.description_en: Keep-alive duration. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports 0-900 seconds; default is 75 seconds.

LBAlgorithm.description_en:
Load balancing algorithm. Specifies the load balancing strategy used by the WAF instance when pulling from the origin. Only required for **CNAME access**.

* wrr: Weighted round robin
* wlc: Weighted least connections
* sh: Source address hash

ProjectName.description_en: Project resource name. For details, refer to [ListDomain - Query cloud WAF instance protected website information](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/waf/ListDomain).

ProtocolFollow.description_en:
Enable protocol follow. When enabled, WAF automatically matches the origin protocol based on the client's request protocol (HTTP/HTTPS). Only required for **CNAME access**. Default is `0` (disabled).

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

* When enabling protocol follow, select both `HTTP` and `HTTPS` in the `Protocols` field.
* This feature is suitable for scenarios where client-WAF-origin protocol consistency is required.

ProtocolPorts.description_en: Access port information. Required only when using **CNAME access**.

Protocols.description_en:
Access protocol type. Only required when using **CNAME access**. Supports single or multiple selections.

* HTTP
* HTTPS

* When `EnableHTTP2=1`, you must select `HTTPS`.
* When `ProtocolFollow=1`, you must select both `HTTP` and `HTTPS`.

ProxyConfig.description_en:
Enable proxy configuration. Default is `0` (disabled). Supported values:

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

ProxyConnectTimeOut.description_en: Connection timeout between WAF and backend server. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports 4-120 seconds, default is 4 seconds.

ProxyKeepAlive.description_en: Number of reusable WAF origin keep-alive connections. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports 60–1000 connections; default is 100.

ProxyKeepAliveTimeOut.description_en: Idle keep-alive timeout. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports 1-60 seconds; default is 15 seconds.

ProxyReadTimeOut.description_en: Timeout for WAF to read responses from the backend server. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports 0-900 seconds, default is 60 seconds.

ProxyRetry.description_en: WAF origin retry count. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports 1-10 times; default is 3 times.

ProxyWriteTimeOut.description_en: WAF request forwarding timeout to backend server. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports 30-3600 seconds; default is 60 seconds.

PublicRealServer.description_en:
CNAME origin access method. **Only required for CNAME access**. Currently supports:

* 1: Public network origin pull

RedirectHTTPS.description_en: When only HTTPS is enabled, you can choose whether to enforce forced redirection; the default value for all settings is true

Region.description_en:
Region where the cloud WAF instance is located.

* cn-beijing: North China 2 (Beijing)
* cn-shanghai: East China 2 (Shanghai)
* cn-guangzhou: South China 1 (Guangzhou)
* ap-southeast-1: Asia Pacific Southeast (Johor)

SSLCiphers.description_en:
SSL cipher suite list. Used to specify the encryption algorithm combinations supported by the HTTPS protocol. Required only for **CNAME access** and when the **protocol type includes HTTPS**.
Different TLS protocol versions support different cipher suites. Each selected TLS protocol version must have at least one corresponding cipher suite. The mapping is as follows:

* TLSv1
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA
   * AES128-SHA
   * AES256-SHA
   * DES-CBC3-SHA
* TLSv1.1
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA
   * AES128-SHA
   * AES256-SHA
   * DES-CBC3-SHA
* TLSv1.2
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA
   * AES128-SHA
   * AES256-SHA
   * DES-CBC3-SHA
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384
   * AES128-GCM-SHA256
   * AES256-GCM-SHA384
   * AES128-SHA256
   * AES256-SHA256
* TLSv1.3
   * TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
   * TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
   * TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256
   * TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256
   * TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256

SSLProtocols.description_en:
TLS protocol version. Only required for **CNAME access** and when **protocol type includes HTTPS**. All versions are selected by default. Supported versions:

* TLSv1
* TLSv1.1
* TLSv1.2
* TLSv1.3

* Selecting only `TLSv1` and `TLSv1.2` is not supported
* The following combinations are supported:
   * `TLSv1` and `TLSv1.1`
   * `TLSv1` and `TLSv1.1`
   * `TLSv1`, `TLSv1.1`, and `TLSv1.2`

TLSEnable.description_en:
Enable log service. Default is 1 (enabled).

* 0: Disabled
* 1: Enabled

TLSFieldsConfig.description_en: Custom configuration for log collection fields.

VolcCertificateID.description_en: Certificate ID hosted in the certificate center. Only required for **CNAME access** and when **protocol type includes HTTPS**. You can query the certificate instance ID information under your account via [CertificateGetInstanceList - Get certificate instance list](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6638/1413343).

VpcID.description_en: VPC ID. Required only for **CNAME access** and when the origin type is **private network origin** (`PublicRealServer=0`). For details on obtaining the ID, see [DescribeVpc](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeVpcs).

EndTime.description_en:
End time for the query. Supports a Unix timestamp (in seconds) or strings like "nd-ago". Leave blank to use the current time
- Timestamp: For example, "1714139668"
- String: Supports queries by day, hour, or minute
  - "nd-ago": n days ago
  - "nh-ago": n hours ago
  - "nm-ago": n minutes ago

StartTime.description_en:
Query start time. Supports second-level timestamps or strings like "nd-ago".
- Timestamp: For example, "1714139668"
- String: Supports querying by day, hour, or minute
  - "nd-ago": n days ago
  - "nh-ago": n hours ago
  - "nm-ago": n minutes ago
You can query data from up to the most recent 30 days

* Enumerated values with keys include:

   * `ARGS:{ArgName}`: Specific request parameter (e.g., `ARGS:device_id`)
   * `COOKIE:{CookieName}`: Specific cookie (e.g., `COOKIE:token`)

StatisticalDuration.description_en:
Statistics time window, in seconds. The value range varies depending on the statistical scenario:

* Frequency limit scenario (`StatisticalType=1`): Value range is 5–1800 seconds
* Repetition statistics scenario (`StatisticalType=2` or `StatisticalType=3`): Value range is 1–60 seconds

StatisticalType.description_en:
Statistics method. Supported values are as follows:

* `1`: Access frequency
* `2`: Number of repetitions
* `3`: Repetition ratio

The relationship between the current path URL and AccurateGroup is AND; the rule is triggered only when both match. In CreateCCRule and UpdateCCRule, do not pass this field if advanced conditions are not enabled or the advanced condition list is empty; when advanced conditions are enabled, Logic and at least one valid AccurateRules must be provided.

AccurateGroupPriority.description_en: Advanced condition priority; not required during creation or update, used only for list display and priority adjustment.

- 6: JS challenge

- 1: On

EffectTime.description_en: Action effective duration, in seconds. Value range: 1~86,400. When the action is rate limiting, blocking, CAPTCHA, or JS challenge, explicit input is recommended.

ExemptionTime.description_en: CAPTCHA or JS challenge exemption time, in seconds. Value range: 1~3,600. After passing verification within the exemption time, users can access normally. If the exemption time ends but the limit duration is still active, verification will be triggered again.

Field.description_en:
Statistics object. Supports single or multiple fields, separated by commas, up to 10 fields. The basic format in external documentation is DataType:Value, for example HEADER:Authorization/COOKIE:PHPSESSID/ARGS:device_id/CLIENTIP. Current code also supports extended statistics objects such as JA3HASH/SESSION-ID/FP. Optional values:
- CLIENTIP: Source IP
- HEADER:{Header-Name}: Specified request header. Header-Name must comply with HTTP header key standards.
- ARGS:{ArgName}: Specified request parameter.
- COOKIE:{CookieName}: Specified cookie.
- JA3HASH: JA3 Hash.
- SESSION-ID: Session ID (only available for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true).
- FP: Client fingerprint (only available for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true).
